npc.mortimer.multi_16: [EN] If any documents are left, you probably find them in the catacombs beneath. Good luck!
npc.mortimer.multi_17: Ai într-adevăr spiritul de aventurier! În sud-estul Tiquanda se află o mică așezare a oamenilor șopârle...
npc.mortimer.multi_18: [EN] Beneath the newly constructed temple there, the lizards hide the said urn. Our attempts to acquire this item were without success ...
npc.mortimer.multi_2: Uneori, broșele de explorator personal pot fi recuperate. Așa aflăm despre soarta membrilor noștri...
npc.mortimer.multi_20: Acest kit de pregătire vă va permite să colectați un fluture violet pe care l-ați ucis...
npc.mortimer.multi_21: [EN] Just use it on the fresh corpse of a purple butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_22: Așa că ascultați, vă rog: luați acest gheață și folosiți-l pe un bloc de gheață din peșterile de sub Folda. Ia niște gheață și adu-o aici cât de repede poți...
npc.mortimer.multi_23: [EN] Should the ice melt away, report on your ice delivery mission anyway. I will then tell you if the time is right to start another mission.
npc.mortimer.multi_24: Excelent, ai adus doar unealta de care avem nevoie! Desigur, a fost doar o sarcină simplă. Cu toate acestea...
npc.mortimer.multi_25: [EN] I officially welcome you to the explorer society. From now on you can ask for missions to improve your rank.
npc.mortimer.multi_26: Bine, deși este nevoie de mai mult decât o simplă pronunțare pentru a se alătura rândurilor noastre. Pentru a-ți dovedi dedicarea față de cauză, va trebui să achiziționezi un articol pentru noi...
npc.mortimer.multi_27: Misiunea ar trebui să fie simplu de îndeplinit. Pentru săpăturile noastre am comandat un târnăcop robust în Kazordoon. Ar trebui să-l cauți pe acest comerciant Uzgod și să ne iei târnacopul...
npc.mortimer.multi_28: Destul de simplu? Ești interesat de această sarcină?
npc.mortimer.multi_29: Am dori să studiem câteva rune antice care au fost folosite de rasa șopârlelor. Suspectăm o relație între șopârlele și fondatorii lui Ankrahmun...
npc.mortimer.multi_3: Oferim o recompensă pentru fiecare broșă returnată nouă. Ai găsit o broșă de explorator?
npc.mortimer.multi_30: Undeva sub orașul infestat de maimuțe Banuta, se pot găsi temnițe care au fost odată locuite de șopârle...
npc.mortimer.multi_31: Căutați acolo o structură atipică care s-ar potrivi mai degrabă cu Ankrahmun și mormintele sale Ankrahmun. Copiați runele pe care le veți găsi pe această structură...
npc.mortimer.multi_33: Am dobândit câteva cunoștințe despre pietrele magice speciale. Unele civilizații pierdute l-au folosit pentru a stoca cunoștințe și știri, la fel cum folosim noi cărți...
npc.mortimer.multi_34: Înțelepciunea din astfel de pietre trebuie să fie imensă, dar la fel sunt și pericolele cu care se confruntă fiecare persoană care încearcă să obțină una...
npc.mortimer.multi_35: Din câte știm, ruinele găsite în nord-vestul Edron au fost odată locuite de ființe care foloseau astfel de pietre. Ai inima să mergi acolo și să ne iei o astfel de piatră?
npc.mortimer.multi_36: Unii membri de rang înalt ar dori să studieze poezia elfică. Ei vor cartea rară 'Songs of the Forest'...
npc.mortimer.multi_37: Cu siguranță cineva din Ab'Dendriel va deține o copie. Deci ar trebui doar să întrebi pe acolo. Sunteți dispus să acceptați această misiune?
npc.mortimer.multi_38: Se știe în mod obișnuit că orcii din Uldereks Rock folosesc un fel de pulbere pentru a crește înverșunatul lupilor și berserkerilor lor de război...
npc.mortimer.multi_39: [EN] What we do not know are the ingredients of this powder and its effect on humans ...
npc.mortimer.multi_4: Ratha a fost un mare explorator și chiar mai mare femeie. Din păcate, nu s-a întors niciodată dintr-o vizită la Amazon. Probabil e mort...
npc.mortimer.multi_40: [EN] So we would like you to get a sample of the aforesaid powder. Do you want to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_41: Vrem să aflăm mai multe despre vechea rasă a stăpânilor oaselor. Credem că piramida neagră la nord-est de Darashia a fost construită inițial de ei...
npc.mortimer.multi_42: Vă rugăm să explorați ruinele piramidei negre și să căutați orice semne care dovedesc teoria noastră. Probabil că veți găsi un document cu limbajul numeric bonelord...
npc.mortimer.multi_43: Asta ar fi o dovadă suficientă. Ți-ar plăcea să accepți această misiune?
npc.mortimer.multi_44: Acest kit de pregătire vă va permite să colectați un fluture roșu pe care l-ați ucis...
npc.mortimer.multi_45: [EN] Just use it on the fresh corpse of a red butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_46: Acest kit de pregătire vă va permite să colectați un fluture albastru pe care l-ați ucis...
npc.mortimer.multi_47: [EN] Just use it on the fresh corpse of a blue butterfly, return the prepared butterfly to me and give me a report of your butterfly hunt.
npc.mortimer.multi_48: Cele mai bune minți ale noastre au venit cu teoria că, în adâncul insulei de gheață Folda, se poate găsi gheață veche. Pentru a demonstra această teorie, am avea nevoie de o mostră din gheața menționată mai sus...
npc.mortimer.multi_49: [EN] Of course the ice melts away quickly so you would need to hurry to bring it here ...
npc.mortimer.multi_5: Societatea oferă o recompensă substanțială pentru recuperarea lui Ratha sau a rămășițelor sale. Ai vești despre Ratha?
npc.mortimer.multi_50: [EN] Would you like to accept this mission?
npc.mortimer.multi_51: Ambele sculpturi sunt acum încărcate și armonizate. În teorie, ar trebui să poți călători în timp zero de la o bază la alta...
npc.mortimer.multi_52: Cu toate acestea, va trebui să aveți o perlă de orichalc în posesia dumneavoastră pentru a o folosi ca sursă de energie. Acesta va fi distrus în timpul procesului. Vă voi oferi 6 astfel de perle și puteți cumpăra altele noi în bazele noastre...
npc.mortimer.multi_53: În plus, trebuie să fii un explorator premium pentru a folosi călătoria astrală. ...
npc.mortimer.multi_54: Și ține minte: este un mic teleport pentru tine, dar un mare teleport pentru toți tibienii! Iată un mic cadou pentru eforturile tale!
npc.mortimer.multi_55: Cu obiectele pe care le-ați furnizat, cercetătorii noștri vor face progrese constante. Totuși, ne lipsesc câteva rezultate ale testelor de la colegii exploratori...
npc.mortimer.multi_56: [EN] Please travel to our base in Port Hope and ask them to mail us their latest research reports. Then return here and ask about new missions.
npc.mortimer.multi_57: Cercetarea ectoplasmei face progrese bune. Acum avem nevoie de un articol spectral. Oamenii noștri de știință cred că o rochie spectrală ar fi un obiect perfect pentru studiile lor...
npc.mortimer.multi_58: [EN] The bad news is that the only source to got such a dress is the queen of the banshees. Do you dare to seek her out?
npc.mortimer.multi_59: Poveștile acelea sunt pur și simplu uimitoare! Bărbați cu fețe pe burtă în loc de capete spuneți? Și găinile care depun ouă de aur? Întrucât, cel mai uimitor este această fântână a tinereții pe care ai menționat-o! ...
npc.mortimer.multi_6: Bine, doar ia această esență spectrală și folosește-o pe sculptura ciudată din această clădire, precum și pe țigla corespunzătoare din baza noastră din Northport...
npc.mortimer.multi_60: Voi trimite imediat câțiva dintre cei mai dedicați exploratori ai noștri să verifice aceste lucruri!
npc.mortimer.multi_7: De îndată ce ați încărcat plăcile portalului în acest fel, raportați despre portalurile spectrale.
npc.mortimer.multi_8: Este destul de curajos. Știm, este mult ce cerem. Regina banshees-urilor locuiește în așa-numitele Ghostlands, la sud-vest de Carlin. Se zvonește că bârlogul ei este situat în cele mai adânci temnițe de sub acel loc blestemat...
npc.mortimer.multi_9: Orice violență va fi probabil zadarnică, va trebui să negociezi cu ea. Încercați să obțineți o rochie spectrală de la ea. Noroc.
npc.mortimer.say_1: Vrei să te alături societății exploratorilor?
npc.mortimer.say_10: [EN] The reports from Port Hope have already arrived here and our progress is astonishing. We think it is possible to create an astral bridge between our bases. Are you interested to assist us with this?
npc.mortimer.say_11: [EN] Did you get the requested pickaxe from Uzgod in Kazordoon?
npc.mortimer.say_12: Ai primit gheața pe care o căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_13: Misiunea vă cere să colectați câteva specii de fluturi, vă interesează?
npc.mortimer.say_14: Ați achiziționat fluturele violet pe care îl căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_15: Ați achiziționat fluturele albastru pe care îl căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_16: Ați achiziționat fluturele roșu pe care îl căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_17: În această misiune, vă solicităm să ne aduceți câteva mostre de plante din plantele Tiquandan. Ți-ar plăcea să îndeplinești această misiune?
npc.mortimer.say_18: Ați achiziționat eșantionul plantei de clopoței junglei pe care o căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_19: Folosește acest recipient de botanist pe un cazan de vrăjitoare pentru a colecta o probă pentru noi. Adu-l aici și raportează despre colecția ta de plante.
npc.mortimer.say_2: Da, un subiect interesant. Am avut discuții vii despre această descoperire. Dar ce vrei tu?
npc.mortimer.say_20: Ați achiziționat eșantionul cazanului de vrăjitoare pe care îl căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_21: Folosiți recipientul acestui botanist pe un trandafir uriaș din junglă pentru a obține o probă pentru noi. Adu-l aici și raportează despre colecția ta de plante.
npc.mortimer.say_22: Ați achiziționat eșantionul de trandafir uriaș din junglă pe care îl căutăm?
npc.mortimer.say_23: Societatea de exploratori ar dori să achiziționeze o urnă antică care este un fel de relicvă pentru oamenii șopârle din Tiquanda. Ți-ar plăcea să accepți această misiune?
npc.mortimer.say_24: Ai reușit să obții urna antică?
npc.mortimer.say_25: Ați găsit vreo dovadă că piramida a fost construită de stăpâni?
npc.mortimer.say_26: Ați achiziționat o parte din pudra de orci?
npc.mortimer.say_27: [EN] Did you acquire a copy of 'Songs of the Forest' for us?
npc.mortimer.say_28: Ați reușit să obțineți o piatră de memorie pentru societatea noastră?
npc.mortimer.say_29: Ați creat o copie a runelor antice așa cum ați cerut?
npc.mortimer.say_3: [EN] The missions available for your rank are the {butterfly hunt}, {plant collection} and {ice delivery}.
npc.mortimer.say_30: Vom vedea dacă poți face față acestei sarcini simple. Luați târnacopul de la Uzgod în Kazordoon și aduceți-l la una dintre bazele noastre. Raportează acolo despre târnăcop.
npc.mortimer.say_31: Tocmai la timp. Din păcate, nu a mai rămas multă gheață, dar va merge. Multumesc din nou.
npc.mortimer.say_32: *Suftat* Cred că este momentul potrivit să-ți mai acordăm o șansă de a obține acea gheață. Grăbește-te de data asta.
npc.mortimer.say_33: Puțin bătut, dar va merge. Multumesc! Dacă crezi că ești gata, cere o altă vânătoare de fluturi.
npc.mortimer.say_34: Puțin bătut, dar va merge. Multumesc! Dacă crezi că ești gata, cere o altă vânătoare de fluturi.
npc.mortimer.say_35: Aceasta este o specie extraordinară pe care ai adus-o. Multumesc! Acesta a fost ultimul fluture de care aveam nevoie.
npc.mortimer.say_36: Amenda! Aici luați acest recipient al botanistului. Folosiți-l pe o plantă de clopoței din junglă pentru a colecta o probă pentru noi. Raportați despre colecția dvs. de plante când ați avut succes.
npc.mortimer.say_37: Înțeleg. Se pare că ai un eșantion destul de util din pură noroc. Multumesc! Spune-mi doar când ești gata să continui cu colectarea plantelor.
npc.mortimer.say_38: Ah, în sfârșit. Am început să mă întreb ce ți-a luat atât de mult. Dar multumesc! Un alt eșantion bun, într-adevăr. Spune-mi doar când ești gata să continui cu colectarea plantelor.
npc.mortimer.say_39: Ce mostră minunată! Cu asta ți-ai încheiat misiunile de colectare a plantelor.
npc.mortimer.say_4: [EN] The missions available for your rank are {lizard urn}, {bonelord secrets} and {orc powder}.
npc.mortimer.say_40: Da, aceasta este relicva prețuită pe care o căutăm de atâta timp. Ai făcut o treabă grozavă, mulțumesc.
npc.mortimer.say_41: Ai făcut-o! Excelent! Lumea științifică va fi zguduită de această descoperire!
npc.mortimer.say_42: Chiar ai inteles? Uimitor! Vă mulțumim pentru eforturile dvs.
npc.mortimer.say_43: Excelent. Această misiune este ușoară, dar totuși vitală. Călătorește la Ab'Dendriel și ia cartea.
npc.mortimer.say_44: Lasă-mă să arunc o privire! Da, asta ne-am dorit. O copie a 'Songs of the Forest'. Nu voi pune nicio întrebare despre acele pete de sânge.
npc.mortimer.say_45: În ruinele din nord-vestul Edron ar trebui să puteți găsi o piatră de memorie. Noroc.
npc.mortimer.say_46: O piatră de memorie fără cusur! Incredibil! Va dura ani chiar și pentru a-ți da seama cum funcționează, dar ce oportunitate pentru știință, mulțumesc!
npc.mortimer.say_47: Excelent! Aici, luați această hârtie de calc și utilizați-o pe obiectul pe care îl veți găsi acolo pentru a crea o copie a runelor antice.
npc.mortimer.say_48: Este puțin șifonat, dar se va descurca. Mulțumesc din nou.
npc.mortimer.say_49: Bun! Luați acest recipient și folosiți-l pe o fantomă care a fost ucisă recent. Întoarce-te cu ectoplasma colectată și dă-mi acel recipient...
npc.mortimer.say_5: [EN] The missions available for your rank are {elven poetry}, {memory stone} and {rune writings}.
npc.mortimer.say_51: Pf, habar n-aveam că ectoplasma va mirosi că... oh, tu ești, ei bine, îmi pare rău. Mulțumesc pentru ectoplasmă.
npc.mortimer.say_52: [EN] Good! Ask me for another mission.
npc.mortimer.say_53: Săraca Ratha. Vă mulțumim că ați returnat acest craniu societății. Vom avea grijă de o înmormântare onorabilă a lui Ratha.
npc.mortimer.say_55: Minunat! Ai adus un ciocan uriaș de fierar pentru societatea de exploratori!
npc.mortimer.say_57: Este întotdeauna o zi tristă când aflăm despre moartea unui membru. Dar măcar am aflat despre soarta lui. Mulțumesc, aici este recompensa ta.
npc.mortimer.say_6: Societatea exploratorilor are nevoie de mult ajutor în cercetarea călătoriilor astrale. Ești dispus să ajuți?
npc.mortimer.say_61: Societatea de exploratori caută un ciocan de fierar uriaș pentru colecția noastră. Se zvonește că ciclopzii din Câmpiile Havocului ar putea folosi unul. Ați obținut întâmplător un astfel de ciocan?
npc.mortimer.say_7: Ai cu tine niște ectoplasmă colectată?
npc.mortimer.say_9: Oh, da! Spune-i colegului nostru explorator că actele sunt deja prin poștă.
npc.mother_of_jack.greet_msg_1: [EN] I demand an explanation of you entering our house without any invitation.
npc.mother_of_jack.multi_1: [EN] Oh my... he did what? Why was he there? Edron Academy? ...
npc.mother_of_jack.multi_2: [EN] I see... this cannot be. Spectrofuss? Who? Jack! When? How? But why did he do that? Jack!! JACK!! When I find him he owes me an EXPLANATION. Thanks for telling me what he is actually doing in his FREE TIME. ...
npc.mother_of_jack.say_1: [EN] What about him? He's downstairs as he always has been. He never went away from home any further than into the forest nearby. He rarely ever took a walk to Edron, did he?
npc.mother_of_jack.say_2: [EN] Thought so. Of course he wouldn't do anything wrong. And he went where? Edron. Hm. I can see nothing wrong with that. But... he wasn't there often, was he?
npc.mother_of_jack.say_3: [EN] What...? But he wasn't up to something, was he?
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_2: [EN] Oh dear, I can't find anything in here!
npc.mother_of_jack.voice_3: [EN] There is still some dust on the drawer over there. What where you thinking, Jane?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_1: [EN] Wh .. What? How did you get here? Where are all the guards? You .. you could have killed me but yet you chose to talk? What a relief! ...
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_2: [EN] So what brings you here my friend, if I might call you like that?
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_3: [EN] Murderer! But .. I give in, you won!
npc.mr._west.greet_msg_4: [EN] Dictate me your conditions but please, I beg you, spare my life. What do you want?
npc.mr._west.say_1: [EN] Indeed, I can see the benefits of a mutual agreement. I will later read the details and send a letter to your superior.
npc.mr._west.say_2: [EN] Yes, for the sake of my life I'll accept those terms. I know when I have lost. Tell your master I will comply with his orders.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_1: [EN] <grumble> Maybe I should rearrange some warm currents to get rid of this horrible fog.
npc.mr_brandon.voice_2: [EN] All these treasures I cannot reach... what a pity.
npc.mr_morris.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young adventurer. \z If you seek to help me with some things, I might have a little {quest} or {mission} for you.
npc.mr_morris.say_1: [EN] One of our ...less fortunate members lost an ancient amulet somewhere on the island, along with his life. If you could retrieve the amulet at least, there's a little reward. Would you go on that errand?
npc.mr_morris.say_10: [EN] I will reward you if you kill 20 minotaur bruisers. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_11: [EN] The first log book from the first foray group has been stolen by trolls. One wonders what for, as they can hardly read! Anyway, we need it back. Would you go looking for it?
npc.mr_morris.say_12: [EN] Ah, yes, that's it! Torn and gnawed, but, ah well, the information is still retrievable. Thank you. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_13: [EN] Some of those salamanders have crawled into Oressa's herb garden and munched all her Dawnfire herbs. Would you get some fresh herbs?
npc.mr_morris.say_14: [EN] Ah, wonderful. Freshly cut and full of potent... whatever it is it does. Thanks. Here's your reward.
npc.mr_morris.say_15: [EN] This is an undercover thing - the key to the dormitory has disappeared. No one wants to own up who has lost it, at least not to me. Maybe they'll talk to you. I'll reward you if you find it. You in?
npc.mr_morris.say_16: [EN] Wonderful. I don't believe you will find Dormovo alive, though. He would not have stayed abroad that long without refilling his inkpot for his research notes. But at least the amulet should be retrieved.
npc.mr_morris.say_17: [EN] Good. The logbook or whatever is left of it is very valuable to my research. If you return its contents to me, I will reward you accordingly.
npc.mr_morris.say_18: [EN] Good. Killing 20 will teach them a lesson, without provoking desperate retaliation. Still, take care!
npc.mr_morris.say_2: [EN] Ah, you found the amulet! Ah. Really? Poor Dormovo. Always a bit hasty. Forgot his rope, or food, or potions - it was to be expected he would meet an early end. Oh, well. ...
npc.mr_morris.say_3: [EN] Splendid. Those Dawnfire buds are just the thing against nasty troll bites, you know? But they're quite rare.
npc.mr_morris.say_4: [EN] Look for a bush with yellow glowing flower buds. It grows only on a special, light grey-brown sand, and is usually surrounded by fireflies. Use the herb to pluck off the fresh flower buds, and return to me.
npc.mr_morris.say_5: [EN] Mountain trolls are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_6: [EN] I will reward you if you kill 20 mountain trolls. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_7: [EN] Footmen of the muglex clan are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.say_8: [EN] I will reward you if you kill 20 muglex clan footmen. Would you do that?
npc.mr_morris.say_9: [EN] Minotaur bruisers are worse than magpies, stealing everything that's not nailed down. Lately, they have raided our ship and made off with most of the Captain's rum stock!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_1: [EN] I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_10:
[EN] Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_11:
[EN] There's three things that need to be found. You can look for an {amulet}, \z
			a {log book} or pick some rare {herbs}. Take your pick.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_12:
[EN] Well, those monsters have grown very uppity lately. There's a choice of three - mountain {trolls}, \z
			muglex clan {goblins} or, if you are up to it or together with some friends, \z
			there's a need to weed out some risky {minotaur} bruisers. Choose your target.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_14:
[EN] There's always someone who needs to be at the front, to take the first step into the unknown. \z
			My whole life has been full of such steps.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_15:
[EN] Ah, that old story of how it was named? I spread it around. \z
			Can't remember really what its origins are. Interesting archeological findings here, though.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_16:
[EN] Ah yes. Well, the magic that led us here seems to be most potent at a certain time, close before sunrise. \z
			Perhaps like a giant pulse, or beacon. Maybe the gods set it here, or a mad sorcerer, \z
			we don't know for sure yet... The portal deep down in the caves, resonating with magical energy where you came \z
			through, can maybe bring something else into this world as well. \z
			So it must be carefully guarded while we investigate the island for more clues... \z
			There are some very interesting archeological findings here on the island throughout. \z
			Seems the island has drawn some cults here, but why they are gone now, no one knows.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_17:
[EN] It seems that throughout its history, this island was inhabited by very different species. \z
			I like to study their remains.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_18:
[EN] Yeah. Long time I haven't been to that place. How's old Vascalir? Still hanging around in the academy? \z
			And Kraknaknork? Hah, I remember our brawl after that last card game. Fun times.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_19:
[EN] What about him? Is he in one of his dark moods again? That's his normal mood, I mean. \z
			Just buy your armor, weaponry and ammunition there and don't worry.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_2: [EN] Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_20: [EN] Tired of the academy, maybe, but not of teaching. If you need druid or sorcerer spells, go to him.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_21:
[EN] Ah, good old Hamish. A real wizard with potions. \z
			Will supply you with very useful magic equipment for hunting.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_3: [EN] There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_4: [EN] Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_5:
[EN] <sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
		Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_6: [EN] So much to investigate, so little time...
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_7: [EN] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_8: [EN] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.mr_morris.stdmod_9:
[EN] Hm. Well, you look like you want to take a look at the unknown yourself. \z
			I might have a job for you. Choose what you would like to do - {fetch} some things, or {kill} some monsters.
npc.mr_morris.voice_1: [EN] I have a quest that needs doing. Interested?
npc.mr_morris.voice_2: [EN] Hmmm. Interesting. If only someone could help investigate this.
npc.mr_morris.voice_3: [EN] There's a task for an intrepid adventurer open! Any volunteers?
npc.mr_morris.voice_4: [EN] Hey, you. Yes, you. I could use your help.
npc.mr_morris.voice_5:
[EN] <sigh> The Adventurers' Guild really should have equipped me with more man power. \z
		Who's to keep all those monsters in check?
npc.mr_morris.voice_6: [EN] So much to investigate, so little time...
npc.mr_morris.voice_7: [EN] Buying all sorts of creature products!
npc.mr_morris.voice_8: [EN] You're looking thoughtful. Maybe I can help you?
npc.muhad.farewell_msg_1: [EN] May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muhad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, foreigner under the sun of Darama. What brings you {here}?
npc.muhad.multi_1: [EN] I appreciate your will to help the sons of the desert. Recently a bunch of thieves have stolen something very valuable from us. It is a secret the true sons kept for aeons and I am not allowed to tell you about it. ...
npc.muhad.multi_2: [EN] If you press the eye of the hawk symbol a secret passage will appear that leads to their hideout. Once inside you have to look for a small casket. ...
npc.muhad.multi_3: [EN] Try to sneak in undetectedly and bring back our treasure as soon as you obtain it. May Daraman hold his protective hand over you on your mission. I wish you good luck. ...
npc.muhad.multi_4: [EN] One last thing before you leave. Take the path behind me and you will get out of our hideout unharmed.
npc.muhad.multi_5: [EN] One last thing before you leave. Take the path behind me and you will get out of our hideout unharmed.
npc.muhad.multi_6: [EN] Ahh, I know that some of my people fear that Arito tells the old secrets of our race and want to see him dead but I don't bear him a grudge. I will have to have a serious word with my people. ...
npc.muhad.multi_7: [EN] Tell him that he can consider himself as acquitted. He is not the reason for our attacks towards {Ankrahmun}.
npc.muhad.multi_8: [EN] In the wink of an eye he left us and was never seen again. I think he feared revenge for leaving us - which partially is not without reason. Why are you asking me about him? Did he send you to me?
npc.muhad.multi_9: [EN] In the wink of an eye he left us and was never seen again. I think he feared revenge for leaving us - which partially is not without reason. Why are you asking me about him? Did he send you to me?
npc.muhad.stdmod_1: [EN] I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_2: [EN] I am the leader of the true sons of {Daraman}.
npc.muhad.stdmod_3: [EN] This is our home - the land of the desert.
npc.muhad.stdmod_4: [EN] We will fight that city until we get back what belongs to us.
npc.muhad.stdmod_5: [EN] We avoid these places you call cities.
npc.muhad.stdmod_6: [EN] I would go crazy living in a cage like that.
npc.muhad.stdmod_7: [EN] We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.stdmod_8: [EN] That is the curse for not following the rules of the desert. No son of the desert has ever come back from the dead.
npc.muhad.stdmod_9: [EN] We have nothing that would be of value for you.
npc.muhad.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] May Daraman be with you on your travels.
npc.muriel.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|! Looking for wisdom and power, eh?
npc.muriel.multi_1: [EN] Great! Here is the container for the bone. Once, I used it to collect ectoplasma of ghosts, but it will work here as well. ...
npc.muriel.multi_2: [EN] If you lose it, you can buy a new one from the explorer's society in North Port or Port Hope. Ask me about the mission when you come back.
npc.muriel.multi_3: [EN] I am so glad you are still alive. Benjamin found the container with the bone sample inside. Fortunately, I inscribe everything with my name, so he knew it was mine. ...
npc.muriel.multi_4: [EN] I thought you have been haunted and killed by the undead. I'm glad that this is not the case. Thank you for your help.
npc.muriel.multi_5: [EN] The rotworms dug deep into the soil north of Thais. Rumours say that you can access a place of endless moaning from there. ...
npc.muriel.multi_6: [EN] No one knows how old that common grave is but the people who died there are cursed and never come to rest. A bone from that pit would be perfect for my studies.
npc.muriel.multi_7: [EN] Indeed, there is something you can do for me. You must know I am researching for a new spell against the undead. ...
npc.muriel.multi_8: [EN] To achieve that I need a desecrated bone. There is a cursed bone pit somewhere in the dungeons north of Thais where the dead never rest. ...
npc.muriel.multi_9: [EN] Find that pit, dig for a well-preserved human skeleton and conserve a sample in a special container which you receive from me. Are you going to help me?
npc.muriel.say_1: [EN] Indeed there is something to be done, but I need someone more experienced. Come back later if you want to.
npc.muriel.say_10: [EN] Oh, sorry but you don't have enough colourful feathers!
npc.muriel.say_11: [EN] I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me three porcelain masks. For the second addon you need fifty colourful ostrich feathers. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.muriel.say_12: [EN] What do you have for me: the porcelain masks or the colourful feathers?
npc.muriel.say_13: [EN] I provide two addons. For the first one I need you to bring me three porcelain masks. For the second addon you need fifty colourful ostrich feathers. Do you want one of these addons?
npc.muriel.say_14: [EN] Ohh, then I need to find another adventurer who wants to earn a great reward. Bye!
npc.muriel.say_2: [EN] Excellent! Now I can try to put my theoretical thoughts into practice and find a cure for the symptoms of undead. Here, take this for your efforts.
npc.muriel.say_3: [EN] I am very glad you helped me, but I am very busy at the moment.
npc.muriel.say_4: [EN] I see you have the porcelain masks. Are you ready to exchange them for the first addon?
npc.muriel.say_5: [EN] I see you have the colourful feathers. Are you ready to exchange them for the second addon?
npc.muriel.say_6: [EN] You need the outfit and 3 porcelain masks or 50 colored feathers to get the festive costume accessories.
npc.muriel.say_7: [EN] Very good! You gained the first addon to the festive outfit.
npc.muriel.say_8: [EN] Oh, sorry but you don't have enough porcelain masks!
npc.muriel.say_9: [EN] Very good! You gained the second addon to the festive outfit.
npc.murim.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.murim.voice_1: Nu uitați să vă depuneți banii aici în Banca Globală înainte de a pleca în aventură.
npc.muzir.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.muzir.voice_1: Nu uitați să vă depuneți banii aici în Banca Globală înainte de a pleca în aventură.
npc.myra.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, |PLAYERNAME|. If you are looking for sorcerer {spells} don't hesitate to ask.
npc.myra.multi_1: [EN] Okay, great! You see, I need a few magical ingredients which I've run out of. First of all, please bring me 70 bat wings. ...
npc.myra.multi_2: [EN] Then, I urgently need a lot of red cloth. I think 20 pieces should suffice. ...
npc.myra.multi_3: [EN] Oh, and also, I could use a whole load of ape fur. Please bring me 40 pieces. ...
npc.myra.multi_4: [EN] After that, um, let me think... I'd like to have some holy orchids. Or no, many holy orchids, to be safe. Like 35. ...
npc.myra.multi_5: [EN] Then, 10 spools of spider silk yarn, 60 lizard scales and 40 red dragon scales. ...
npc.myra.multi_6: [EN] I know I'm forgetting something.. wait... ah yes, 15 ounces of magic sulphur and 30 ounces of vampire dust. ...
npc.myra.multi_7: [EN] That's it already! Easy task, isn't it? I'm sure you could get all of that within a short time. ...
npc.myra.multi_8: Ați înțeles tot ce v-am spus și sunteți dispus să vă ocupați de această sarcină?
npc.myra.say_1: [EN] This Tiara is an award by the academy of Edron in recognition of my service here.
npc.myra.say_10: [EN] Oh, did you bring the 70 bat wings for me?
npc.myra.say_11: [EN] Have you found 20 pieces of red cloth?
npc.myra.say_12: [EN] Were you able to retrieve 40 pieces of ape fur?
npc.myra.say_13: [EN] Did you convince the elves to give you 35 holy orchids?
npc.myra.say_14: [EN] Oh, did you bring 10 spools of spider silk yarn for me?
npc.myra.say_16: [EN] Were you able to get all 40 red dragon scales?
npc.myra.say_17: [EN] Have you collected 15 ounces of magic sulphur?
npc.myra.say_18: [EN] Have you gathered 30 ounces of vampire dust?
npc.myra.say_19: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_20: [EN] Thank you! I really needed them for my anti-wrinkle lotion. Now, please bring me 20 pieces of red cloth.
npc.myra.say_21: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_22: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_23: [EN] Great! This should be enough for my new dress. Don't forget to bring me 40 pieces of ape fur next!
npc.myra.say_24: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_25: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_26: [EN] Nice job, player. You see, I'm testing a new depilation cream. I guess if it works on ape fur it's good quality. Next, please bring me 35 holy orchids.
npc.myra.say_27: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_28: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_29: [EN] Thank god! The scent of holy orchids is simply the only possible solution against the horrible stench from the tavern latrine. Now, please bring me 10 rolls of spider silk yarn.
npc.myra.say_3: [EN] Well... maybe, if you help me a little, I could convince the academy of Edron that you are a valuable help here and deserve an award too. How about it?
npc.myra.say_30: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_31: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_32: [EN] I appreciate it. My pet doggie manages to bite through all sorts of leashes, which is why he is always gone. I'm sure this strong yarn will keep him. Now, go for the 60 lizard scales!
npc.myra.say_33: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_34: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_35: [EN] Good job. They will look almost like sequins on my new dress. Please go for the 40 red dragon scales now.
npc.myra.say_36: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_37: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_38: [EN] Thanks! They make a pretty decoration, don't you think? Please bring me 15 ounces of magic sulphur now!
npc.myra.say_39: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_4: [EN] Before I can nominate you for an award, please complete your task.
npc.myra.say_40: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_41: [EN] Ah, that's enough magic sulphur for my new peeling. You should try it once, your skin gets incredibly smooth. Now, the only thing I need is vampire dust. 30 ounces will suffice.
npc.myra.say_42: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_43: [EN] No, no. That's not enough, I fear.
npc.myra.say_44: [EN] Ah, great. Now I can finally finish the potion which the academy of Edron asked me to. I guess, now you want your reward, don't you?
npc.myra.say_45: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.say_46: [EN] This Tiara is an award by the academy of Edron in recognition of my service here.
npc.myra.say_47: [EN] Go to the academy in Edron and tell Zoltan that I sent you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.say_5: [EN] Go to the academy in Edron and tell Zoltan that I sent you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.say_6: [EN] I don't have any tasks for you right now, |PLAYERNAME|. You were of great help.
npc.myra.say_8: [EN] Fine! Let's start with the 70 bat wings. I really feel uncomfortable out there in the jungle.
npc.myra.say_9: [EN] Would you like me to repeat the task requirements then?
npc.myra.task_1: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 70 bat wings, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_10: [EN] Go to the academy in Edron and tell Zoltan that I sent you, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_11: [EN] I don't have any tasks for you right now, |PLAYERNAME|. You were of great help.
npc.myra.task_2: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 20 pieces of red cloth, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_3: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 40 pieces of ape fur, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_4: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 35 holy orchids, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_5: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 10 spools of spider silk yarn, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_6: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 60 lizard scales, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_7: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 40 red dragon scales, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_8: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 15 ounces of magic sulphur, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myra.task_9: [EN] Your current task is to bring me 30 ounces of vampire dust, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.myzzi.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello adventurer. It is {good} to see you.
npc.myzzi.multi_1: [EN] I know only little and I forget so much. So many things going around my mind! ...
npc.myzzi.multi_2: [EN] However, I can grant you access to the {Courts} of Summer and Winter if you promise to help! There you can meet with Undal or Vanys, the servants of Lord Cadion and Lady Alivar. They will be able to tell you more about the issue.
npc.myzzi.say_1: [EN] I'm just a mere messenger and I'm here to find brave adventurers that might {help} my friends in this time of need.
npc.myzzi.say_2: [EN] Lady Alivar of the Summer Court and Lord Cadion of the Winter Court are in need of brave adventurers to avert a great {threat} for the whole world.
npc.myzzi.say_3: [EN] There are {entrances} to the hidden Courts of Summer and Winter in secluded places. You can find the portal to the Winter Court high in the mountains of Tyrsung and the portal to the Summer Court in the meadows of Feyrist. ...
npc.myzzi.say_4: [EN] So, are you willing to help in this time of need?
npc.myzzi.say_5: [EN] You are a true hero! Here, take my enchantment and you will be able to pass the portals. Now hurry, my friends are waiting.
npc.myzzi.voice_1: [EN] You need to find some heroes. Find, find, find!!
npc.nah_bob.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Bye now, Neutrala |PLAYERNAME|. Visit old Bob again one day!
npc.nah_bob.multi_2: |PLAYERNAME|, aproape că a sunat ca un cuvânt de salut. Oamenii - drăguți sunt!
npc.nah_bob.say_1: Vai! Un om! Acesta nu este un loc pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|. Du-te și joacă-te în altă parte.
npc.nah_bob.say_2: [EN] <Sighs> Another {customer}! I've only just sat down! What is it, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.nah_bob.say_3: [EN] You brought cookies! How nice of you! Can I have one?
npc.nah_bob.say_4: Nu ai nicio prăjitură pe care mi-aș dori.
npc.nah_bob.say_5: [EN] You see, good deeds like this will ... YOU ... YOU SPAWN OF EVIL! I WILL MAKE SURE THE MASTER LEARNS ABOUT THIS!
npc.nah_bob.say_7: [EN] I'm sorry, human. But you need Gabel's permission to trade with me.
npc.nah_bob.sendtrade_msg_1: La dispoziția dumneavoastră, doar răsfoiți prin marfa mea.
npc.naji.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome to the Tibian bank, |PLAYERNAME| What can I do for you?
npc.naji.voice_1: [EN] It's a wise idea to store your money in your bank account.
npc.narsai.say_1: [EN] Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.narsai.say_2: [EN] Here is the list of ingredients that are missing to complete the ritual.
npc.narsai.say_4: [EN] Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.narsai.say_5: [EN] Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.navigator.multi_1: [EN] I control EVERYTHING from this room, navigating the fate of this land for more than a century now. Can you see all these funnels? My voice travels through them and throughout everything down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_10: [EN] And then I laid my eyes on a creature I have never seen before. I now know that they call themselves Njey. You would call them the 'Creatures of the Deep' or 'Deeplings'. ...
npc.navigator.multi_11: [EN] I am now convinced that when they first saw me descending in that suit with the light of the shimmer glower encompassing me, they took me for their God King Qjell. And that's when it all started to make sense. Don't you agree?
npc.navigator.multi_12: [EN] I was once captain of a ship, the Skyflare. We were traders for King Tibianus and on our way home when we got into a storm. We fought hard to escape the cold grip of the sea. ...
npc.navigator.multi_13: [EN] I myself did what I could to navigate the Skyflare out of this mess. They depended on me. Me, the navigator. And I succeeded. ...
npc.navigator.multi_14: [EN] However, when the sea calmed down and the rain was finally gone, we recognised that our ship wouldn't move. It wasn't my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_15: [EN] There was a strong gale and we could already see this island on the horizon. There were seagulls all around the Skyflare to lead us to dry land. But the ship did not move a single inch. It was NOT my fault. ...
npc.navigator.multi_16: [EN] We dived under the bow and saw that it was stuck right on the tip of a sharp rock. The world below us was treacherous, we could see large underwater mountains and a labyrinthine system of caves and holes. ...
npc.navigator.multi_17: [EN] Some of my men panicked and hijacked the dinghies to reach the island, others tried to swim. I remained on the ship. It was not my FAULT. It was not. ...
npc.navigator.multi_18: [EN] When none of my men returned, I forced myself to make a decision. Either dying on this dead ship or plunging into the liquid black beneath. ...
npc.navigator.multi_19: [EN] In my desperation my thoughts fell onto a strange armor - a gift from a trader we dealt with just before the storm. Strange ornaments and fish-like elements decorated this armor. We thought it would fit just perfectly into the captain's cabin. ...
npc.navigator.multi_2: [EN] The stones on the beach? The trader up there? That was ME ALL THE TIME! I lured YOU into creating all this chaos up there and down here! ...
npc.navigator.multi_20: [EN] He said something like a 'blessed breath' and 'to subdue the drift'. We thought he wanted to sell us worthless decoration and make it look interesting. If I had only listened to what he said. ...
npc.navigator.multi_21: [EN] I figured that this thing would have something to do with diving or at least protect me from the icy water. I put it on, grabbed a shimmer glower from our storage to light my path and jumped in. ...
npc.navigator.multi_22: [EN] Do you want me to go on?
npc.navigator.multi_23: [EN] NAAAAARGH. If you promise to leave me alone and NOT TO TELL MY SECRET to anyone - you can have one. ...
npc.navigator.multi_24: [EN] NO! Not the one I'm wearing. I am BOUND to this device. This suit has granted me a longer life. However, once you have spent a certain time with this - there is no turning back if you know what I mean. ...
npc.navigator.multi_25: [EN] The armor will merge with your very body. Holding you captive, holding your life in its hands like a ransom. ...
npc.navigator.multi_26: [EN] Using Deepling craft and various components from down here, I created several spare helmets - just in case this one gets damaged. If you return that small golden anchor to me, you can have one. Will you?
npc.navigator.multi_3: [EN] You thought you could choose sides? Think again! I nearly led you into the destruction of two species! ME, THE NAVIGATOR! I CONTROL YOU, I OWN YOU! QJELL AFAR GOU JEY!
npc.navigator.multi_4: [EN] Of course you do. And they did, too. They obeyed me. They adored me. They followed me. ...
npc.navigator.multi_5: [EN] I learnt everything about their culture, their life, their goals and their problems. I found out about vile insect-like creatures inhabiting the surface of the island. And their waiting for the return of Qjell. ...
npc.navigator.multi_6: [EN] I practically rewrote their history. I WAS THE SECOND COMING. I WAS QJELL. I, THE NAVIGATOR. ...
npc.navigator.multi_7: [EN] And I navigated them out of their miserable lives. Away from their petty interests. I led them to a greater purpose - to form chaos out of order, to bring back the storm to the seas and to make THINGS MOVE. Do you want to hear the rest as well?
npc.navigator.multi_8: [EN] Hmpf. The armor was working. After some time I was surrounded by darkness and could only see as far as my shimmer glower would me allow to. But I didn't feel the cold - I could even breathe through that helmet. ...
npc.navigator.multi_9: [EN] I dived into the deep black. Across rugged mountains, vast fields of kelp, swarms of strange fish. ...
npc.navigator.say_1: [EN] Lhnjei gouthn naumpi! I know why you are here. I can {explain} everything.
npc.navigator.say_2: [EN] By entering this place, you have earned the right to learn what this is all about. This is a long story. Are you sure you want to hear this, {yes}?
npc.navigator.say_3: [EN] Do you have enough, can I stop?
npc.navigator.say_4: [EN] Then take this one. And remember: DO NOT TELL ANYONE ABOUT ME OR ANYTHING YOU HAVE HEARD HERE TODAY.
npc.nelly.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|, What can I do for you? I'm working for the post office, but I also trade with important {potions}, {runes} and other magical equipment.
npc.nelly.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.nelly.voice_1: Bine ați venit la oficiul poștal!
npc.nelly.voice_2: [EN] Also selling runes, potions and magical equipment!
npc.nielson.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ahoi, young man |PLAYERNAME| and welcome to the Nordic Tibia Ferries. If you need a {passage}, let me know.
npc.nielson.stdmod_2: [EN] Do you want a round-trip passage to {0} for {1}?
npc.nielson.stdmod_5: [EN] Where do you want to go today? We serve the routes to {Folda}, {Senja} and {Vega} and back to Tibia.
npc.nielson.voice_1: [EN] Passages to Senja, Folda and Vega.
npc.nilsor.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, traveller |PLAYERNAME|. Is there anything I can {do for you}?
npc.nilsor.multi_1: [EN] A thousand thanks in advance. I need no less than 7 ingredients for the cure. You can ask me about each specifically ...
npc.nilsor.multi_10: [EN] Are you willing to help me?
npc.nilsor.multi_2: [EN] I need a part of the sun adorer cactus, a vial of geyser water, sulphur of a lava hole, a frostbite herb, a blossom of a purple kiss, a hydra tongue and spores of a giant glimmercap mushroom ...
npc.nilsor.multi_3: [EN] Turn them in individually by talking about them to me. As soon as I obtained them all, talk to me about the medicine. First time bring a Part of the Sun Adorer {Cactus}.
npc.nilsor.multi_4: [EN] You will need a specially prepared waterskin to collect the water. You can buy one from me ...
npc.nilsor.multi_5: [EN] Use it on a geyser that is NOT active. The water of active geysers is far too hot. You can find inactive geysers on Okolnir. Do you have some geyser water with you?
npc.nilsor.multi_6: [EN] Thank you. Now I have all necessary ingredients. As a reward I grant you the use of our dog sled, which is located to the east of here. ...
npc.nilsor.multi_7: [EN] The dogs can be a bit moody, but if you always carry some ham with you there shouldnt be any problems. Oh, and Hjaern might have a mission for you. So maybe you go and talk to him.
npc.nilsor.multi_8: [EN] I am in dire need of help. A plague has befallen my dogs. I even called a druid of Carlin for help but all he could do was to recommend some strong medicine ...
npc.nilsor.multi_9: [EN] The thing is the ingredients of the medicine are extremely rare and some only exist in far away and distant lands. If you could help me collecting the ingredients, I would be eternally grateful ...
npc.nilsor.say_1: [EN] Do you want to travel to Svargrond?
npc.nilsor.say_10: [EN] The giant glimmercap mushroom exists in caves and other preferably warm and humid places. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on a mushroom to collectits spores. Do you have the glimmercap spores?
npc.nilsor.say_13: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Geyser {Water} in a Waterskin.
npc.nilsor.say_14: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_15: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me Fine {Sulphur}.
npc.nilsor.say_16: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_17: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the Frostbite {Herb}
npc.nilsor.say_18: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_19: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient Now bring me Purple Kiss {Blossom}.
npc.nilsor.say_2: [EN] What for ingredient do you have?
npc.nilsor.say_20: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_21: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me the {Hydra Tongue}
npc.nilsor.say_22: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_23: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now bring me {Spores} of a Giant Glimmercap Mushroom.
npc.nilsor.say_24: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_25: [EN] Thank you for this ingredient. Now you finish your {mission}
npc.nilsor.say_26: [EN] Come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_27: [EN] Then come back when you have the ingredient.
npc.nilsor.say_3: [EN] I have now no mission for you.
npc.nilsor.say_4: [EN] Do you want to buy a waterskin for 25 gold?
npc.nilsor.say_5: [EN] You will find this kind of cactus at places that are called deserts. Only an ordinary kitchen knife will be precise enough to produce the ingredient weneed. Do you have a part of that cactus with you?
npc.nilsor.say_6: [EN] I need fine sulphur of an inactive lava hole. No other sulphur will do. Use an ordinary kitchen spoon on an inactive lava hole. Do you have fine sulphur with you?
npc.nilsor.say_7: [EN] The frostbite herb is a local plant but its quite rare. You can find it on mountain peaks. You will need to cut it with a fine kitchen knife. Do you have a frostbite herb with you?
npc.nilsor.say_8: [EN] The purple kiss is a plant that grows in a place called jungle. You will have to use a kitchen knife to harvest its blossom. Do you have a blossom of a purple kiss with you?
npc.nilsor.say_9: [EN] The hydra tongue is a common pest plant in warmer regions. You might find one in a shop. Do you have a hydra tongue with you?
npc.nina.greet_msg_1: [EN] Beware, if you go any further you will have to fight a large group of Chosen. This place is called the Fire Dragon Dojo. Tread carefully since these are lizard training grounds.
npc.nina.stdmod_1: [EN] The lizards here are the chosen ones of their kind. We believe them to be the strongest warriors in these lands.So I lead my people here to learn their ways. We are mere assassins but they are using foreign techniques and seem to be far more efficient
npc.nina.stdmod_2: [EN] We of the Grey Shadow clan are studying the ways of the Chosen. Our training is hard, encounters with the lizards often deadly. Every one of us fights on his own. Each one more deadly than the other. Under my lead we wil rise renewed, as the Shadow Nina.
npc.nina.stdmod_3: [EN] I am Nina, leader of the Grey Shadow clan. Me and my followers, the Shadow Nina, are exploring the largely uncharted parts of the continent Zao.
npc.ninev.farewell_msg_1: Fie ca zeii să te binecuvânteze, |PLAYERNAME|!
npc.ninev.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, young |PLAYERNAME|! If you are heavily wounded or poisoned, I can {heal} you for free or you want the {adventurer stone}?
npc.ninev.keyword_1: Așa că primește protecția întorsăturii destinului, pelerine.
npc.ninev.stdmod_1: [EN] Alright, I guess you need a stake first. Maybe Gamon can help you, the leg of a chair or something could just do. Try asking him for a stake, and if you have one, bring it back to me.
npc.ninev.stdmod_11: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești gratis piatra de aventurier?
npc.ninev.stdmod_14: Ah, vrei să înlocuiești piatra de aventurier cu 30 de aur?
npc.ninev.stdmod_18: Ești rănit, copilul meu. Îți voi vindeca rănile.
npc.ninev.stdmod_19: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.
npc.ninev.stdmod_2: [EN] I guess you couldn't convince Gamon to give you a stake, eh?
npc.ninev.stdmod_20: Ori de câte ori primești o rană letală, forța ta vitală este deteriorată și există șansa să pierzi o parte din echipamentul tău. Cu fiecare dintre cele cinci {blessings} pe care le aveți, această daune și șansa de pierdere vor fi reduse.
npc.ninev.stdmod_21: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.ninev.stdmod_22: Văd că ai primit scutul spiritual în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_23: Simt că druidii de la nord de Carlin ți-au oferit Îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_24: Văd că ai primit binecuvântarea celor doi sori în solar lângă Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_25: Îmi dau seama că scânteia phoenixului ți-a fost deja dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_26: Simt că ai vorbit deja cu pustnicul Eremo de pe insula Cormaya și ai primit această binecuvântare.
npc.ninev.stdmod_27: Puteți cere binecuvântarea scuturilor spirituale în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.
npc.ninev.stdmod_28: Druizii la nord de Carlin vă vor oferi îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.
npc.ninev.stdmod_29: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.
npc.ninev.stdmod_3: Da, am fost informat ce să fac. Ești pregătit să primești rândul meu de rugăciune?
npc.ninev.stdmod_30: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.
npc.ninev.stdmod_32:
[EN] A blessed stake to defeat evil spirits? I do know an old prayer which is said to grant sacred power and to be able to bind this power to someone, or something. ... \z
	However, this prayer needs the combined energy of ten priests. Each of them has to say one line of the prayer. ... \z
	I could start with the prayer, but since the next priest has to be in a different location, you probably will have to travel a lot. ... \z
	Is this stake really important enough to you so that you are willing to take this burden?
npc.ninev.stdmod_33:
Aceasta este o binecuvântare specială pe care ți-o pot acorda odată ce ai obținut cel puțin una dintre celelalte binecuvântări și care funcționează puțin diferit. ... \z
	Funcționează doar atunci când ești ucis de alți aventurieri, ceea ce înseamnă că cel puțin jumătate din daunele care au dus la moartea ta au fost cauzate de alții, nu de monștri sau de mediu. ... \z
	{twist of fate} nu va reduce pedeapsa cu moartea la fel ca celelalte binecuvântări, ci, în schimb, vă va împiedica să vă pierdeți celelalte binecuvântări, precum și amuleta pierderii, dacă purtați una. Costa la fel ca si celelalte binecuvantari. ... \z
	Ți-ar plăcea să primești acea protecție pentru un sacrificiu de |PVPBLESSCOST| aur, copile?
npc.ninev.stdmod_4: [EN] So receive my prayer: 'Light shall be near - and darkness afar'. Now, bring your stake to Tibra in the Carlin church for the next line of the prayer. I will inform her what to do.
npc.ninev.stdmod_6: [EN] You should visit Tibra in the Carlin church now.
npc.ninev.stdmod_7: Ai primit deja rândul meu de rugăciune.
npc.ninev.stdmod_8: Așa că primește protecția întorsăturii destinului, pelerine.
npc.ninev.stdmod_9: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.
npc.ninev.walkaway_msg_1: Ține minte: dacă ești grav rănit sau otrăvit, te pot vindeca gratuit.
npc.ninos.farewell_msg_1: A fost o plăcere să vă ajut, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.ninos.greet_msg_1: Buna ziua. Cum te pot ajuta |PLAYERNAME|? Cere-mi un {trade} dacă vrei să cumperi ceva. Pot explica și sistemul {mail}.
npc.ninos.say_1: O, nu se mai schimbă atât de mult de pe vremuri, deoarece... <spune o poveste plictisitoare și confuză despre o prăjitură, un colet, el și două veverițe, cel puțin îți spune în final măsurătorile lui>
npc.ninos.voice_1: Bine ați venit la oficiul poștal!
npc.ninos.voice_2: Dacă aveți nevoie de ajutor cu scrisori sau pachete, întrebați-mă. Pot să explic totul.
npc.ninos.voice_3: Hei, trimite-i o scrisoare prietenului tău din când în când. Ține legătura, știi.
npc.nipuna.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.nipuna.voice_1: [EN] I'm selling magic equipment. Come and have a look.
npc.nipuna.voice_2: [EN] If you need runes, this is the market stall for you!
npc.nokmir.multi_1: [EN] On the next day, the guards brought me to emperor {Rehal}, and Rerun was there, too. He said I had stolen his ring. I'd never steal, you have to believe me.
npc.nokmir.multi_2: [EN] On the next day, the guards brought me to emperor {Rehal}, and Rerun was there, too. He said I had stolen his ring. I'd never steal, you have to believe me.
npc.nokmir.say_1: [EN] I don't see how you could help me. I'm in deep, deep trouble. I'm accused of having stolen a {ring} from Rerun, but I haven't.
npc.nokmir.say_2: [EN] WHAT?! I can't believe it. You saved my life... well, at least one week of it 'cause that would have been the time I had to spend in jail. If you want to, you can pass the door now and take a look at the northern mines. Have fun!
npc.nokmir.say_3: [EN] Maybe Grombur knows more than me. The thing is he won't talk to me, and he will surely not accuse his best friend as a liar. What a dilemma!
npc.nokmir.say_4: [EN] He's a miner in the southern wing. Maybe he has lost the ring there... but even if I find the ring, no one will believe me. Someone should talk to Grombur. He's Rerun's best friend.
npc.nokmir.say_5: [EN] He's a good emperor but I doubt he is wise enough to see the truth behind that false accusation against me. If just someone would find out the truth about that whole mess.
npc.nomad.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, another diciple of the extreme... surviving the icy outdoors? Let me {help}! If you need some first aid out here, I can provide {healing} or grant you an {enhanced} blessing!
npc.nomad.keyword_1: [EN] Receive the heart of the mountain then.
npc.nomad.stdmod_1: [EN] I am able to grant you the heart of the mountain's blessing. But I must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you willing to part with that amount of wealth?
npc.nomad.stdmod_10: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.
npc.nomad.stdmod_11: [EN] Talk to the hermit Eremo on the isle of Cormaya about this blessing.
npc.nomad.stdmod_12: Druizii la nord de Carlin vă vor oferi îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.
npc.nomad.stdmod_13: [EN] I know of a mysterious djinn, bound to an existence of slavery far to the north of Tiquanda's jungles. He is bound to tell you his secrets and offer you the 'blood of the mountain'. ...\nI do not know where exactly but I guess you must first dig that one out to actually talk to him.
npc.nomad.stdmod_2: [EN] Receive the heart of the mountain then.
npc.nomad.stdmod_3: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.
npc.nomad.stdmod_4: Ești rănit, copilul meu. Îți voi vindeca rănile.
npc.nomad.stdmod_5: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.
npc.nomad.stdmod_6: [EN] Besides the {enhanced} blessing available from me, I know of one other, granted by a solitary {nomad} far west of Svargrond. There are also five different other blessings available, each in a sacred place. ...\nThese blessings are: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}.
npc.nomad.stdmod_7: [EN] Well, as I am quite in a {fix} currently, my only hope to escape this situation may be to grant you {healing} or an {enhanced} blessing if you wish. You must desire SOMETHING, right? Sure you do.
npc.nomad.stdmod_8: Puteți cere binecuvântarea scuturilor spirituale în templul cu flori albe de la sud de Thais.
npc.nomad.stdmod_9: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.
npc.noozer.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hm? Oh! Oh, yes a... visitor! Intruder? Benefactor...? Wha- what are you? If you want to pass through this cave, I may have to disappoint you. Or maybe not. It... depends. So, just passing through?
npc.noozer.multi_1: [EN] ...wait a second, I lost it. What was I going to say again? Ah yes - DANGEROUS! These. Caves. Are. Dangerous. No way you get out alive. Ever. Again. ...
npc.noozer.multi_2: [EN] Also you should not disturb those... people down there. Yeah. They... hm, wait, they - who are they again? Hey! Who are you? Are you talking to me?! Ah, ah... oh yes, I remember. ...
npc.noozer.multi_3: [EN] Wait - I am the guardian here, yes! The keeper of... something... or another, yes, I... guard this place. With my life. Don't I? Of course! ...
npc.noozer.multi_4: [EN] Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.multi_5: [EN] Is, er... this the moment where I should try to... stop you? Yes? No? Ah, you know what - you go down there, those guys are angry as dung anyway. Try your luck, return to me when you're done. If you still can. Or not.
npc.noozer.say_1: [EN] I was stationed in this cave to... guard something. Right now I am not even sure what that was.
npc.noozer.say_2: [EN] Then don't waste my time. I'm doing some important... business... here. Actually... where am I? If I find out, I will be even more angry than I am now. Out of my sight.
npc.noozer.say_3: [EN] I was on a mission, too - I guess. It was all quite blurry back then. Maybe I'll leave this place after I recovered completely. I have to find out what happened to me.
npc.nor.say_1: [EN] Here, take the memory crystal and leave immediately.
npc.norf.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, pilgrim. How may I {help} you? Are you in need of {healing}?
npc.norf.keyword_1: [EN] So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_1: [EN] Here in the whiteflower temple you may receive the blessing of spiritual shielding. But we must ask of you to sacrifice |BLESSCOST| gold. Are you still interested?
npc.norf.stdmod_10: Îmi dau seama că scânteia phoenixului ți-a fost deja dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_11: Simt că ai vorbit deja cu pustnicul Eremo de pe insula Cormaya și ai primit această binecuvântare.
npc.norf.stdmod_12: Druizii la nord de Carlin vă vor oferi îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_13: Puteți cere binecuvântarea celor doi sori în bronzul de lângă Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norf.stdmod_14: Scânteia phoenixului este dată de preoții pitici ai pământului și focului în Kazordoon.
npc.norf.stdmod_2: [EN] So receive the shielding of your spirit, pilgrim.
npc.norf.stdmod_3: Amenda. Sunteți liber să refuzați oferta mea.
npc.norf.stdmod_4: Ești rănit, copilul meu. Îți voi vindeca rănile.
npc.norf.stdmod_5: Nu arăți așa de rău. Scuze, nu te pot ajuta. Dar dacă cauți protecție suplimentară, ar trebui să mergi pe {pilgrimage} de cenușă sau să obții protecția {twist of fate} aici.
npc.norf.stdmod_6: Ori de câte ori primești o rană letală, forța ta vitală este deteriorată și există șansa să pierzi o parte din echipamentul tău. Cu fiecare dintre cele cinci {blessings} pe care le aveți, această daune și șansa de pierdere vor fi reduse.
npc.norf.stdmod_7: [EN] There are five blessings available in five sacred places: the {spiritual} shielding, the spark of the {phoenix}, the {embrace} of Tibia, the fire of the {suns} and the wisdom of {solitude}. Additionally, you can receive the {twist of fate} here.
npc.norf.stdmod_8: Simt că druidii de la nord de Carlin ți-au oferit Îmbrățișarea lui Tibia.
npc.norf.stdmod_9: Văd că ai primit binecuvântarea celor doi sori în solar lângă Ab'Dendriel.
npc.norma.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome, welcome! Have a seat! If you like a drink or something to eat, just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.say_1: [EN] Oh, you're back already? Did you bring a legion helmet, 100 chicken feathers and 50 honeycombs?
npc.norma.say_2: [EN] Pretty, isn't it? I made it myself, but I could teach you how to do that if you like. What do you say?
npc.norma.say_3: [EN] Okay, here we go, listen closely! I need a few things... a basic hat of course, maybe a legion helmet would do. Then about 100 chicken feathers... and 50 honeycombs as glue.That's it, come back to me once you gathered it!!
npc.norma.say_4: [EN] Aw, I guess you don't like feather hats. No big deal.
npc.norma.say_5: [EN] Sorry, but I can't see a legion helmet.
npc.norma.say_6: [EN] Sorry, but you don't enough chicken feathers.
npc.norma.say_7: [EN] Sorry, but you don't have enough honeycombs.
npc.norma.say_8: [EN] Great job! That must have taken a lot of work. Okay, you put it like this... then glue like this... here!
npc.norma.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take all the time you need to decide what you want!
npc.norma.stdmod_1: [EN] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.stdmod_10: [EN] I've never been better! I love my new {job}!
npc.norma.stdmod_11: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Obi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need a weapon.
npc.norma.stdmod_12: [EN] As an adventurer, you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.norma.stdmod_13: [EN] Ah, the monsters are far away. Let's party now!
npc.norma.stdmod_14: [EN] If you really want to talk about dungeons, visit Dallheim on the bridge near my bar.
npc.norma.stdmod_15: [EN] Ewww, I don't even want to think about the smell from the sewers right now!
npc.norma.stdmod_16: [EN] Oooh, I wouldn't dare gossiping about the king. He might have his spies here somewhere, you know.
npc.norma.stdmod_17: [EN] This is the world we live in, oh-oh-oh, and these are the hands we're given, oh-oh... oh, I'm sorry, I got carried away!
npc.norma.stdmod_18: [EN] As a premium adventurer you have many advantages, you should check them out!
npc.norma.stdmod_19: [EN] I serve the best drinks in town! What's it gonna be, lemonade? Wine? Milk? Beer? Just ask me for a {trade}!
npc.norma.stdmod_2: [EN] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.stdmod_20: [EN] The temple is a good place to visit if you're in urgent need for healing.
npc.norma.stdmod_21: [EN] Well, the only help I could give you are some general {hints}. And a delicious {drink} along with it.
npc.norma.stdmod_22: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_23: [EN] No sorry, I'm out of that business. Please ask {Dixi} or {Lee'Delle} if you need equipment.
npc.norma.stdmod_24: [EN] Oh, would you like something to eat or drink? Ask me for a {trade} to see my offers!
npc.norma.stdmod_25: [EN] <gets a dreamy look in her eyes>
npc.norma.stdmod_26: [EN] Al Dee treats his customers friendly, but he's badmouthing them once he had a few beers.
npc.norma.stdmod_27: [EN] I'm curious about her adventures. She really should come here more often!
npc.norma.stdmod_28: [EN] He got lucky when Willie and him played a game of dice about who gets to farm on which side of the river. Ever since, Willie holds a grudge against him.
npc.norma.stdmod_29: [EN] Hehe, that guy doesn't pretend to be anyone that he isn't. He is what he is - rude, but honest.
npc.norma.stdmod_30: [EN] Oh shush! It's kinda disgusting when he walks in here with animal blood on his hands!
npc.norma.stdmod_31: [EN] What Seymour doesn't teach you is how much fun you can have here!
npc.norma.stdmod_32: [EN] I invited her to my bar, but she refused. Oh well, it was worth a try!
npc.norma.stdmod_33: [EN] I think that poor guy never gets a break from work. At least he never comes here.
npc.norma.stdmod_34: [EN] That guy seriously needs some partying and a girlfriend.
npc.norma.stdmod_35: [EN] The oracle is on the top floor of the academy. You should go there once you are level 8 to leave this island.
npc.norma.stdmod_36: [EN] I think it's rather strange that he lives here with his granddaughter. No one's ever seen the parents of {Dixi}.
npc.norma.stdmod_37: [EN] I hate that name, it sounds so boring. Almost like 'normal'. I think I should change my name to something more exciting. Like... Marylin! Oh, what a glamorous sound!
npc.norma.stdmod_38: [EN] She told me that she dreams of leaving this island to go on a big adventure.
npc.norma.stdmod_4: [EN] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.stdmod_5: [EN] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.stdmod_7: [EN] I used to be a merchant, but being a barkeeper is so much more fun. It's been my dream since I was a little girl.
npc.norma.stdmod_8: [EN] It's about |TIME|. Time just flies, doesn't it?
npc.norma.stdmod_9: Pentru a vedea ofertele unui comerciant, pur și simplu vorbiți cu acesta și cereți un {trade}. Îți vor arăta cu plăcere ofertele lor și, de asemenea, lucrurile pe care le cumpără de la tine.
npc.norma.voice_1: [EN] Great drinks and snacks at fair prices!
npc.norma.voice_2: [EN] You know you want a party after all that tiring hunting!
npc.norma.voice_4: [EN] Sing and dance at my bar! Yeah!
npc.norma.voice_5: [EN] Best place in town! Come to my bar!
npc.norma.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Hey, where are you going? We've just started!
npc.nurik.greet_msg_1: [EN] It's .. It's YOU! At last!! So what's this special proposal you would like to make, my friend?
npc.nurik.multi_1: [EN] Excellent! Here is the painting you requested. It's quite precious to my father, but imagine his joy when I tell him about my clever deal! ...
npc.nurik.multi_2: [EN] Now leave me alone please. I have to prepare for my departure. Now my family will not call me a squandering fool anymore!
npc.nurik.multi_3: [EN] That's just incredible! I've dreamed about acquiring the dwarven bridge since I was a child! Now my dream will finally become true. ...
npc.nurik.multi_4: [EN] And you are sure you want to sell it? I mean really, really sure?
npc.nurik.say_1: [EN] Excuse me, but I'm waiting for someone important!
npc.nurik.say_2: [EN] Wait a minute! Do I get that right? You're the owner of the dwarven bridge and you are willing to sell it to me??
npc.nurik.say_3: [EN] How splendid! Do you have the necessary documents with you?
npc.nurik.say_4: [EN] Oh my, oh my. I'm so excited! So let's seal this deal as fast as possible so I can visit my very own dwarven bridge. Are you ready for the transaction?
npc.nydala.sendtrade_msg_1: Aruncă o privire. Majoritatea mobilierului vine în truse la îndemână. Folosește-le în casa ta pentru a asambla mobila. Vrei să vezi doar un anumit {type} de mobilier?
npc.nydala.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, as you can see, I sell furniture. Ask me for a {trade} if you're interested to see my wares.
npc.nydala.stdmod_2: [EN] My name is Nydala. I run this store.
npc.nydala.stdmod_3: [EN] It is |TIME|. Do you need a clock for your house?
npc.obi.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Farewell, I hope you were satisfied with our service.
npc.obi.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, hello, |PLAYERNAME|! Please come in, look, and buy! If you like to see my offers, ask me for a {trade}!
npc.obi.stdmod_1: [EN] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_10: [EN] It's about |TIME|. Yes, |TIME|. I'm so sorry, I have no watches for sale.
npc.obi.stdmod_11: [EN] My name is Obi, just Obi, the honest merchant. If you like to {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_12: [EN] I'm a merchant and the local {weapon} smith. If you like to see my quality wares or sell weapons to me, ask me for a {trade}.
npc.obi.stdmod_13: [EN] As an adventurer you should always have at least a {backpack}, a {rope}, a {shovel}, a {weapon}, an {armor} and a {shield}.
npc.obi.stdmod_14: [EN] If I were you, I'd invest my money in quality steel rather than putting it in a so-called safe bank account!
npc.obi.stdmod_15: [EN] Well, the mainland also consists of several continents. You can go there once you are level 8 and have talked to the {oracle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_16: [EN] Ah, Rookgaard. Home sweet home, that's what it became for me, but I will always miss {Thais} and {Sam}.
npc.obi.stdmod_17: [EN] Oh, Thais, I'll be back. One day, I'll be back.
npc.obi.stdmod_18: [EN] My good old cousin Sam. Oh, how I miss him.
npc.obi.stdmod_19: [EN] I think good practice is better than reading a boring book. Of course, you will need proper {equipment} to be able to get practice!
npc.obi.stdmod_20: [EN]  told them to let me sell food, but no! Sorry, you have to ask {Willie} or {Billy} on the farms west of here.
npc.obi.stdmod_21: [EN] Good monsters to start with are rats. They live in the {sewers} under the village of {Rookgaard}.
npc.obi.stdmod_22: [EN] There are many sewer entrances throughout Rookgaard. One is right outside this shop and to the left. For more details about monsters and dungeons, best talk to one of the {guards}.
npc.obi.stdmod_23: [EN] The bridge guard {Dallheim} is north of here, just follow the street, you can't miss it.
npc.obi.stdmod_24: [EN] Sadly, not many merchants are as honest as I am.
npc.obi.stdmod_25: [EN] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Lily}.
npc.obi.stdmod_26: [EN] There are many blueberry bushes in and around this village. Nature's for free.
npc.obi.stdmod_27: [EN] I'm fine. It's a little hot near the crucible, but I enjoy the sound of forging {weapons}.
npc.obi.stdmod_28: [EN] Just ask me for a {trade} to see which things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_29: [EN] Oh, just upstairs. My granddaughter {Dixi} is in charge of selling armors and shields.
npc.obi.stdmod_3: [EN] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.stdmod_30: [EN] Yes, I'm selling weapons. Just ask me for a {trade} to see my offers and the things I buy from you.
npc.obi.stdmod_31: Ei bine, fără aur, fără înțelegere. Câștigă aur luptând cu {monsters} și ridicând lucrurile pe care le poartă. Vinde-l la {merchants} pentru a face profit!
npc.obi.stdmod_32: [EN] I wish I could help you with that, but no, I was told to stick to weapons. Go see {Al Dee} or {Lee'Delle}.
npc.obi.stdmod_33: [EN] I sell {weapons} of all kinds. Just ask me for a {trade} if you like to see my offers.
npc.obi.stdmod_34: [EN] I don't know how anyone could give up the flourishing business she led. She should have listened to me and find someone who continues that business for her.
npc.obi.stdmod_35: [EN] I told him there was no danger, but he wouldn't listen to me, no one listens to me.
npc.obi.stdmod_36: [EN] I suggested him opening a tourist guide company with me, Obi's and Santiago's, but he didn't approve. I really don't understand why.
npc.obi.stdmod_37: [EN] An old woman shouldn't be treated like that, no way, that's bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_38: [EN] Oh, this guy is so greedy, so greedy. Ripping off poor adventurers like you!
npc.obi.stdmod_39: [EN] She is beautiful, very, very beautiful. I hope I can impress her somehow.
npc.obi.stdmod_4: [EN] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.obi.stdmod_41: [EN] This guy doesn't understand that he should entrust me with the food business, too. He really should do. Then he had time for his farm.
npc.obi.stdmod_42: [EN] He shouldn't heal people for free, no he shouldn't. That would be a great source of income for the village that could be invested in enhancing the smithy.
npc.obi.stdmod_43: [EN] Oh, what an endearing little girl, and she's working so hard to help me, even without receiving payment. Such a sweet little girl!
npc.obi.stdmod_44: [EN] I don't like him, actually I dislike him deeply. He is so greedy that he doesn't want to share his profit he gains from health potions.
npc.obi.stdmod_45: [EN] She ruins the market with her offers! This is bad for us honest merchants, really bad.
npc.obi.stdmod_46: [EN] I knew it! I knew she would try to get the monopoly on potions in this village! But no one has listened to me!
npc.obi.stdmod_47: [EN] The oracle, ah, such a weird being! It will lead you off this island once you are level 8, yes it will, mark my words.
npc.obi.stdmod_5: [EN] Well, how can I help you? Do you need some general {hints}? Or, if you're interested in a {trade}, just ask.
npc.obi.stdmod_6: [EN] What kind of information do you need? I could tell you about different topics such as {equipment}, {monsters} or {Rookgaard} in general.
npc.obi.stdmod_8: [EN] Be careful down there! Make sure you bought enough {torches} and a {rope} or you might get lost.
npc.obi.stdmod_9: Regele a încurajat vânzătorii să călătorească aici, dar numai eu am îndrăznit să-mi asum riscul și a fost un risc!
npc.obi.voice_1: [EN] Only quality steel and wood used for my weapons!
npc.obi.voice_3: [EN] Selling and buying all sorts of weapons, come and have a look!
npc.obi.voice_4: [EN] Give those monsters a good whipping with my weapons!
npc.oblivion.greet_msg_1: [EN] A shadow preceded you. You wish?
npc.oblivion.multi_1: [EN] Ah, the Lady of Darkstone. You have done well to remember her name. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_2: [EN] Now, the shadows say the thing you seek lies next to Akab, the Quarrelsome. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_3: [EN] No coal is burned in his honour. Find his resting place and dig near it. Now go.
npc.oblivion.multi_4: [EN] Then into the vampire crypts, deep down, you must go. ...
npc.oblivion.multi_5: [EN] There... three graves where the shadows swirl, unseen. The first one: name the colour of the silent gong. Then ...
npc.oblivion.multi_6: [EN] The second: the name that is silent now in the halls of Darkstone ...
npc.oblivion.multi_7: [EN] The third: the lost beauty of Dunesea. It must be remembered, the shadows command it. Go now.
npc.oblivion.say_1: [EN] Lost. Hidden. The keys are shadow names. Find them, they will talk to me and reveal what is hidden. Will you go on that quest?
npc.oblivion.say_2: [EN] Yes. Have you gone there and found what you sought?
npc.oblivion.say_3: [EN] Tell me. Begin with the colour.
npc.oblivion.say_4: [EN] Yes. The shadows say this is true. The beauty of House Dunesea, name it.
npc.oblivion.say_5: [EN] The floating gardens. Too beautiful to lie asleep in the memory of men. Yes. The name that is no more in Darkstone?
npc.ocelus.multi_1: [EN] Oh yes, I noticed that lovely mermaid. From afar of course. I would not dare to step into the eyes of such a lovely creature. ...
npc.ocelus.multi_2: [EN] ... I guess I am quite shy. Oh my, if I were not blue, I would turn red now. If there would be someone to arrange a {date} with her.
npc.ocelus.say_2: [EN] Oh my. Its not easy to impress a mermaid I guess. Please get me a {love poem}. I think elves are the greatest poets so their city seems like a good place to look for one.
npc.ocelus.say_3: [EN] Will you ask the mermaid Marina if she would date me?
npc.ocelus.say_4: [EN] Thank you. How ironic, a human granting a djinn a wish.
npc.ocelus.say_5: [EN] Excellent. Here, with this little spell I enable you to recite the poem like a true elven poet. Now go and ask her for a date again.
npc.ocelus.say_6: [EN] Did you get a love poem from Ab'Dendriel?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_1: [EN] Do you seek a passage to the {0} end for {1}?
npc.old_adall.stdmod_3: [EN] I can bring you either to the east end of Port Hope or to the west end of the town, where would you like to go?
npc.oldrak.goshnar: [EN] The greatest necromant who ever cursed our land with the steps of his feet. He was defeated by the nightmare knights.
npc.oldrak.greet_msg_1: [EN] Welcome |PLAYERNAME|! Only rarely I can welcome {visitors} these days.
npc.oldrak.job: [EN] I guard this humble temple as a monument for the order of the {nightmare knights}.
npc.oldrak.monster: [EN] These plains are not safe for ordinary travellers. It will take heroes to survive here.
npc.oldrak.multi_1: [EN] You chopped down the demon oak?!? Unbelievable!! Let's hope it doesn't come back. As long as evil is still existent in the soil of the plains, it won't be over. Still, the demons suffered a setback, that's for sure. ...
