npc.sinclair.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings |PLAYERNAME|. I have - very - little time, please make it as short as possible. I may be able to help you if you are here to help us with any of our tasks or missions.
npc.sinclair.multi_1: [EN] We are still in need of more research concerning environmental as well as psychic ecto-magical influences. Besides more common ghosts we also need some of the harder to come by nightstalkers and - if you're really hardboiled - souleaters. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_10: [EN] Alright, the device is holding it. The magical barrier should be able to contain nearly 20 times the current load. That's a complete success! Spectulus, are you seeing this? We did it! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_11: [EN] Well, you did! You really helped us pulling this off. Thank you Lord Stalks! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_12: [EN] I doubt we will have much time to hunt for new specimens ourselves in the near future. If you like, you can continue helping us by finding and capturing more and different ghosts. Just talk to me to receive a new task.
npc.sinclair.multi_13: [EN] Excellent. Now we need to concentrate on testing that thing. The spirit cage has been calibrated based on some tests we made - as well as your recent findings over at the graveyard. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_14: [EN] Using the device on the remains of a ghost right after its defeat should capture it inside this trap. We could then transfer it into our spirit chamber which is in fact a magical barrier. ..
npc.sinclair.multi_15: [EN] At first, however, we need you to find a specimen and bring it here for us to test the capacity of the device. Are you ready for this?
npc.sinclair.multi_2: [EN] We will of course pay for every ghost you catch. You will receive more if you hunt for some of the tougher fellows - but don't overdue it. What do you say?
npc.sinclair.multi_3: [EN] Magnificent! Alright, we will at least need 5 caught ghosts. We will pay some more if you can catch 5 nightstalkers. Of course you will earn some more if you bring us 5 souleaters. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_4: [EN] I heard they dwell somewhere in that new continent - Zao? Well anyway, if you feel you've got enough, just return with what you've got and we will see. Good luck! ...
npc.sinclair.multi_5: [EN] Keep in mind that the specimens are only of any worth to us if the exact amount of 5 per specimen is reached. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_6: [EN] Furhtermore, to successfully bind Nightstalkers to the cage, you will need to have caught at least 5 Ghosts. To bind Souleaters, you will need at least 5 Ghosts and 5 Nightstalkers. ...
npc.sinclair.multi_7: [EN] The higher the amount of spirit energy in the cage, the higher its effective capacity. Oh and always come back and tell me if you lose your spirit cage.
npc.sinclair.multi_9: [EN] Amazing! I will transfer this to our spirit chamber right about - now! ...
npc.sinclair.say_1: [EN] So, did you find anything worth examining? Did you actually catch a ghost?
npc.sinclair.say_10: [EN]  Alright you found something! Are you really finished hunting out there?
npc.sinclair.say_2: [EN] So you have passed Spectulus' acceptance test. Well, I'm sure you will live up to that. ...
npc.sinclair.say_4: [EN] Talk research with spectulus to take some mission.
npc.sinclair.say_5: [EN] Good, now all you need to do is find a ghost, defeat it and catch its very essence with the cage. Once you have it, return to me and Spectulus and I will move it into our chamber device. Good luck, return to me as soon as you are prepared.
npc.sinclair.say_6: [EN] Go and use the machine in a dead ghost!
npc.sinclair.say_7: [EN] Good, of course you will also receive an additional monetary reward for your troubles. Are you fine with that?
npc.sinclair.say_8: [EN] Alright, let us see how many ghosts you caught!
npc.sinclair.say_9: [EN] You didnt catch the ghost pieces.
npc.sinclair.voice_1: [EN] Indeed, there has to be some other way.
npc.sinclair.voice_3: [EN] Yes indeed, all of the equipment should be checked and calibrated regularly.
npc.sinclair.voice_4: [EN] No, we have to give this another go.
npc.sissek.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.sissek.voice_1: Nu uitați să vă depuneți banii aici în Banca Globală înainte de a pleca în aventură.
npc.sister_of_jack.greet_msg_1: [EN] Mh hello there. What can I do for you?
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_1: [EN] Yesss! So this time he will get it for a change! And he lived there...? He helped whom? Ha! He won't get away this time! What did he do there? I see... interesting! ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_2: [EN] Wait till mother hears that! Oh he will be in for a surprise, I can tell you that. Ma!! Maaaaa!!
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_3: [EN] I knew it! He likes taking extended walks outside, leaving all the cleaning to me - especially when he is working on this sculpture, this... 'thing' he tries to create. ...
npc.sister_of_jack.multi_4: [EN] What did he do? Since you look like a guy from the city, I bet he went to Edron in secrecy or something like that, didn't he? And you are here because of that?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_1: [EN] Why are you asking, he didn't get himself into something again did he?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_2: [EN] Spelltolust?! That sounds awfully nasty! What was he doing there - are you telling me he lived an alternate life and he didn't even tell {mother}?
npc.sister_of_jack.say_3: [EN] What?! And what did he do there? Who did he visit there?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_1: [EN] Where did I put my broom? Mother?
npc.sister_of_jack.voice_2: [EN] Mother?! Oh no, now I have to do this all over again
npc.skjaar.greet_msg_1: [EN] Another creature who believes thinks physical strength is more important than wisdom! Why are you disturbing me?
npc.skjaar.say_1: [EN] I will give the key to the crypt only to the closest followers of my master. Would you like me to test you?
npc.skjaar.say_2: [EN] Before we start I must ask you for a small donation of 1000 gold coins. Are you willing to pay 1000 gold coins for the test?
npc.skjaar.say_3: [EN] All right then. Here comes the first question. What was the name of Dago's favourite pet?
npc.skjaar.say_5: [EN] Perhaps you knew him after all. Tell me - how many fingers did he have when he died?
npc.skjaar.say_6: [EN] Also true. But can you also tell me the colour of the deamons in which master specialized?
npc.skjaar.say_7: [EN] It seems you are worthy after all. Do you want the key to the crypt?
npc.snake_eye.say_1: [EN] So you're the delivery boy? Go ahead, but I warn you, it's quite heavy. You can take it from the box over there.
npc.snake_eye.say_2: [EN] Funny thing that everyone thinks we have forgers for fake documents here. But no, we don't. The best forger is old Ahmet in Ankrahmun.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_2: [EN] Ah hello again |PLAYERNAME|! I still have one or two other {missions} for you. There are also some {tasks} someone needs to attend to.
npc.spectulus.greet_msg_3: [EN] Hello |PLAYERNAME|! You're late, do you have no concept of time? My mission is of utmost importance. If you are not interested in helping me, you might as well just leave.
npc.spectulus.multi_1: [EN] Well, if you really want to delve into this - I could use some help. So you have found my machine on that island? And you found the notes with the coordinates? Then you can find the entrance! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_10: [EN] At first, take this gold for the passage by ship and return to the Gray Island from where I started my expedition many years ago. From there you should find a way to reach the Gray Beach of Quirefang as no ordinary ship can land there. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_11: [EN] I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well youll find out yourself soon enough, wont you?
npc.spectulus.multi_12: [EN] I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well youll find out yourself soon enough, wont you?
npc.spectulus.multi_13: [EN] You do? Well, the end of this story was that I had to leave the place. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_14: [EN] I couldnt explore what lies below the stairs as there was an unpredictable stream. Diving into these waters would have been an uncontrollable risk, even with the means to survive without any air. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_15: [EN] So I used the portable teleporting device I installed into my machine in case of an emergency and went home. I could only take the most important research documents with me and had to leave most of my equipment in the cave. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_16: [EN] Of course I also left my final notes with the coordinates there. And for the life of me I cannot remember where I dug that stupid hole. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_17: [EN] When I arrived at home I immediately started looking for a way to manoeuvre in these chaotic conditions once I rediscovered the lost entrance. I never remembered it, but it seems you found it as you indeed have my original notes. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_18: [EN] Oh and just in case you want to complete what I have started - feel free to do so. Up to it?
npc.spectulus.multi_19: [EN] Ah, the machine you found at that island. Well, I built this thing to venture far beneath the very soil we walk on. I suspected something there. Something deep down below. Something evil. Even more so than the dreaded bugs which are crawling my study. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_2: [EN] Just look for a large staircase with sprawling steps. There is an unpassable stream there that will prevent you from venturing further on. But fear not, you can indeed travel down there - with these small enhancements I created. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_20: [EN] Drilling hole after hole only to get stuck in another hard, unbreakable sediment again and again, I was about to quit this pointless enterprise. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_21: [EN] However, the very last day I lingered on that island, I finally fell into a large hollow right under the beach. My drill was shattered and the machine was not mobile anymore. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_22: [EN] I am well aware that this may sound laughable now - at this part all of my colleagues burst into laughter anyway - but suddenly there were stairs. Incredibly large stairs that led to the underworld. A world deep under the sea - can you believe this?
npc.spectulus.multi_23: [EN] Well you know Jack - after all you talked to him in person. He will get over it. As for the real Jack, my former intern... I am glad that nothing serious happened to him. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_24: [EN] According to his letter, he did just fine so many years ago. He somehow managed to make a name of himself when he cast some magic we enhanced through our research - of course no one back then had ever seen such spells. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_25: [EN] Oh and he sends his regards to... how did he put it - 'whoever is currently helping me getting out of whatever mess I am currently in'. I... don't really know how this was meant but I guess this is directed at... you!
npc.spectulus.multi_26: [EN] Success!! Now it will be far easier to convince him of his true self! Excellent work. Now the only thing left to do is to separate him from whatever still binds him to that place. Did he develop any habits perhaps? ...
npc.spectulus.multi_27: [EN] A hobby or something! Yes, ask him about his hobbies! Convince him somehow that anything he is doing there does not match his true self - he didn't have any hobbies except a healthy interest in science - you MUST convince him, no matter what! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_28: [EN] Or everything we achieved would be in vain. We can still save Jack! Now go and do what you must do.
npc.spectulus.multi_29: [EN] Alright listen. As long as his social environment accepts him as the person he is now, he will never come free from the shackles that bind him to this alternate self. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_3: [EN] I will put this under your footgear. Here you go. And this in your nose. There. And there will be no further problems for you down there. Except- ah, well you'll find out yourself soon enough, won't you?
npc.spectulus.multi_30: [EN] Oh, he has a sister you say? And his mother is living with them? ...
npc.spectulus.multi_31: [EN] Hm... that's strange, I don't even recall his family. Never knew he had a mother and a sister. Tell them the truth about him - maybe they will understand and even help him getting this over with. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_32: [EN] But be careful, the {dimensional} shift could mean that they will not even know what you're talking about since they are more closely linked to him than anyone else.
npc.spectulus.multi_33: [EN] A trigger is needed to make him recall what happened. First thing should be to change his environment to be more... familiar. As soon as he will have the things he used to have around him, his memories will come back. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_34: [EN] I know that he used to have a very comfy red cushioned chair and an old globe which sat near the middle of the room. He also used a smaller telescope and he had that extremely large amphora in a corner. And... there was one other thing. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_35: [EN] A rocking horse. He just loved it! Find these items, buy them if you need to and place them where {Jack} lives. Ask him about the furniture and don't forget to tell me about his reaction!
npc.spectulus.multi_36: [EN] But {Jack} is not yet lost to us - if we can get him back to his former self! You have to tell him about his former life, convince him, change his environment. But at first you will need to talk to him and find out who exactly we are dealing with now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_37: [EN] I will mark his current location on your map, just ask him about me and see what happens - good luck.
npc.spectulus.multi_38: [EN] I will mark his current location on your map, just ask him about me and see what happens - good luck.
npc.spectulus.multi_39: [EN] The bad news is, using the device at that state was not a good idea. We effectively caused a magical distortion in the fabric of time, space and thus folded infinity - just a little. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_4: [EN] Mh? Ah, yes yes. 'Njey' is the native-language term for a very old race of undersea creatures which ...
npc.spectulus.multi_40: [EN] The good news is that {Jack} is still on our world, and not even inconveniently far away. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_41: [EN] Unfortunately in the current state of time, he was never interested in attending Edron Academy, he never looked for a job to finance his studies and of course has never been one of my interns. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_42: [EN] Since he was in the magic sphere during the launch, the time fold only affected his own {dimensional} anchoring. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_43: [EN] The number of parallel {dimensions} is endless and the fold made him slip into one completely different course of time where he never was the person I once knew. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_44: [EN] Now you know it all. Still want to help?
npc.spectulus.multi_45: [EN] Now you know it all. Still want to help?
npc.spectulus.multi_46: [EN] He was as eager as you to help me - quite a nice person, really. At the time he was still around I was working on a device to transport its user to any specified point in time - be it back or to the future if you know what I mean. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_47: [EN] He was helping me quite a lot, no matter which task I applied to him. And one day we finally did it, our tempus machina was up and running. He was certainly all man of action when he actually stepped into the machine for our first run. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_48: [EN] The device was designed for one person with enough room for some provisions and one or two books for reading if one would land in some drab solitude. You never know, you know? So we fired it up and yes, it actually worked! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_49: [EN] He completely disappeared right before my eyes! Eureka! Well ahem, there was but one tiny little problem. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_5: [EN] ...hm, wait - only a select few of my colleagues even bothered studying their culture. They are a mere fantasy to the common man - is there anything of importance you want to tell me?
npc.spectulus.multi_50: [EN] As all magical calibration was done from my lab I never thought about adding some sort of control to its interior. In other words {Jack} has travelled in time, without any means to come back. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_51: [EN] Sleepless days of intensive research, however, brought me to the conclusion that he was not actually travelling to the future, but to another {dimension}, {parallel} to ours. There is still a chance to rescue him - and you can help me. What do you say?
npc.spectulus.multi_52: [EN] Sleepless days of intensive research, however, brought me to the conclusion that he was not actually travelling to the future, but to another {dimension}, {parallel} to ours. There is still a chance to rescue him - and you can help me. What do you say?
npc.spectulus.multi_53: [EN] I recently teamed up with a fellow scientist and friend Sinclair, who is also more of an explorer than me, to combine our discoveries in the field of complex phenomena not that easily to describe just by today's state of magic. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_54: [EN] Of course I am talking about ghosts. I know, I know. Hard to believe in those times of highly advanced magic we live in. Yet there are some things, we fail to explain. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_55: [EN] And that is exactly where we come in! Oh, and you of course. We will not only explain them - we will ''remove'' them. Just tell me whenever you are ready to help us with our research.
npc.spectulus.multi_57: [EN] Three: You can explain at least three of the following terms, infestations, collective apparitions, ectoplasmic segregations, ecto-magical field phenomena, neuro-speculative sub-conscious awareness of spirits, ghosts and/or ghasts.
npc.spectulus.multi_59: [EN] ...and how shiny it is, almost there ...
npc.spectulus.multi_6: [EN] There are rumours of aggressive fishmen in northern Tiquanda. We have to find out if this is even remotely connected to the Njey. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_60: [EN] ...now wh- no, NO, NOOO! It just ...
npc.spectulus.multi_61: [EN] ...slipped. And cracked. Don't look at me like that ...
npc.spectulus.multi_62: [EN] ...I need some time to get over this. What? Oh, yes you can take the remains if you like. Just get it out of my sight.
npc.spectulus.multi_63: [EN] A debacle, catastrophe, disaster - I need time to fully understand what chance just slipped through our hands here... hm? Oh yes, yes through my hands, my hands of course. Now would you please leave me alone?!
npc.spectulus.multi_64: [EN] Alright, now listen. West of Edron, near the ocean, you'll find the Lost Mines. Go down there to recover one of its rare crystals. But beware, people say the mine workers who died there years ago in an horrible accident are still digging. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_65: [EN] I will mark the location of the mines on your map. Be careful when entering these muddy depths and don't forget that you will need a pick to gather the crystals.
npc.spectulus.multi_66: [EN] That's the spirit! As time is of the essence, we should start right now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_67: [EN] A beggar here in Edron brags about how smart he is and that he knows about a man who lost his sanity because of an experiment, but he won't tell anyone any details. Maybe he knows more.
npc.spectulus.multi_68: [EN] You remember me explaining the fold in time, causing a tiny disturbance in infinity? Well, as I already told you, {Jack} was indeed not transported to the future... but to the past. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_69: [EN] I received some kind of letter this morning that has been stored for me by the Academy for about 70 years now. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_7: [EN] What's puzzling me is that they were sighted above ground and then retreated into a temple ruin. If we find that ruin, we could find out if there's a relation. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_70: [EN] It said it should be opened at a specific day 20 years ago to prevent this whole incident but I wasn't even at the Academy by that time. Someone just found the letter earlier today and brought it to my attention. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_71: [EN] So our {Jack} here was in fact... a completely different person. Now, now... don't get upset, there was no chance for me to warn you earlier! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_72: [EN] And it wasn't all that bad, was it? Heh... I mean... everyone needs a change in life now and then! And he can still come here if he likes to! ...
npc.spectulus.multi_73: [EN] Or wait - erm... better not tell him where exactly I live, I have some kind of presentiment concerning that whole affair... yes, we should just leave everything as it is now, indeed we should. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_74: [EN] Anyway you did a great job and I thank you for... putting your hands into my fire Player... once again.
npc.spectulus.multi_75: [EN] Anyway you did a great job and I thank you for... putting your hands into my fire Player... once again.
npc.spectulus.multi_76: [EN] Did you find a rare crystal? Show me... Amazing, absolutely amazing. This crystal alone is worth a small fortune. Ahem, of course I'm glad you brought it to me for further research instead of bringing it to a merchant. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_77: [EN] Please return here if you want to continue helping me with another mission.
npc.spectulus.multi_78: [EN] Alright, now that we have enough results, the analysing can start. While I do this, I will need you to test the magically enhanced cage Sinclair developed to contain spirits effectively. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_79: [EN] Take the spirit cage from him and use it on the essence of a common ghost. Its essence will then be sucked into the cage and we can study him right here in the safety of the academy walls.
npc.spectulus.multi_8: [EN] Are you willing to help me?
npc.spectulus.multi_80: [EN] I fine-tuned another set of devices. You are the lucky candidate to first lay eyes on some revolutionary new concepts. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_81: [EN] Are you ready to help science once again?
npc.spectulus.multi_82: [EN] Alright. Let's go. At first we need to find out more about ghosts in general. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_83: [EN] I still need more information and values to properly calibrate the magical orientation of orange and turquoise sparkle attractors which we will need to actually contain ghost-emissions. ...
npc.spectulus.multi_9: [EN] Just look for a large staircase with sprawling steps. There is an unpassable stream there that will prevent you from venturing further on. But fear not, you can indeed travel down there - with these small {enhancements} I created. ...
npc.spectulus.say_1: [EN] You are back, how did the measurements go? Did you recognise anything of interest?
npc.spectulus.say_10: [EN] Well, the only thing left to do would be to offer the crystal at the well of the collector. There must be a pedestal near the well, where you need to put your donation. Ha, do you think you could do that?
npc.spectulus.say_11: [EN] Found the well yet? Look on one of the ice isles near Carlin. I'm perfectly sure that the well with the pedestal is located on one of them. And be careful with the carrying device, I only have this one prototype.
npc.spectulus.say_12: [EN] So have you found the well and entered the lair? I hope you can find the {mirror crystal} in there. It is the only way to finish the {Lightboat}.
npc.spectulus.say_13: [EN] Put the mirror crystal into the special carrying device I gave you and bring it directly to me.
npc.spectulus.say_14: [EN] Do you have the mirror crystal? Unbelievable! Alright I will extract the crystal from the device myself, would you please give me the device with the crystal and step back?
npc.spectulus.say_15: [EN] After the debacle with the crystal, I started focussing on other things. There are also some {tasks} that still need to be done. If you can spare the time to continue helping me, it shall not be to your disadvantage. So are you in for another mission?
npc.spectulus.say_16: [EN] So you found him? Have you talked to {Jack} yet?
npc.spectulus.say_17: [EN] You're back from {Jack}! Mh, by the looks of your face I doubt our little redecoration project yielded any success. But I had an even better idea while you were gone - ready to give it another try?
npc.spectulus.say_18: [EN] So, did you talk to his family? Were you able to convince them?
npc.spectulus.say_19: [EN] Did you find out what hobby {Jack} has? Did you separate him from this activity? Only if he has a free mind, he can truly get back to his former self! Now all you need to do is talk to him again!
npc.spectulus.say_2: [EN] Alright, you look bright enough to fulfil my requests - at least you do not fall asleep while standing there. Ahem... I heard about a certain inventor who created a {magic device} to actually sail the {sea of light}. Will you help me find him?
npc.spectulus.say_20: [EN] The device needs a special crystal. It's called {mirror crystal}. The inventor somehow damaged it - with fatal results. He had to give up, as no second crystal was left to try. I, however, know of another one... but are you up to the task?
npc.spectulus.say_21: [EN] One remaining mirror crystal is in the hands of a creature called the collector which collects all kinds of crystals. The only way to get access to its lair is to donate a very rare crystal to a secret well. I need you to get one, will you help me?
npc.spectulus.say_22: [EN] Good, because if you wouldn't do it... listen, this well is on one of the isles near Carlin. There you offer the crystal. Once you get access to its lair, find the collector and... convince it to give you the mirror crystal. Understood?
npc.spectulus.say_23: [EN] To collect the unbelievably rare, practically unique mirror crystal, you will need to use this special carrying device I developed. If you find the crystal, use it to store it and transport it safely to me. There is no second one.
npc.spectulus.say_24: [EN] Of course you are. And here we go. I have to ask some questions first. One: You aint afraid of no ghost, right?
npc.spectulus.say_25: [EN] Good. Two: You know that ghosts exist and/or have found and/or defeated one or more of them?
npc.spectulus.say_26: [EN] Good. Take this wand - we call it a spirit meter - and go to the graveyard I have marked on your map and take a few measurements on the graves.
npc.spectulus.say_27: [EN] Let me see the spirit meter. Hmmm... those are grave news you bring - uhm, you know what I mean. But this is awesome! Now I know for sure that the calibration is only some short bursts of magically enhanced energy away.
npc.spectulus.say_28: [EN] Yes? And he didn't remember anything? Not even me? That's not good. Then we will have to do everything ourselves. Are you ready to continue?
npc.spectulus.say_29: [EN] Ah well, let's forget about the scientific details - you will do just fine as long as you do exactly what I say. Ready for me to go on with your task?
npc.spectulus.say_3: [EN] You should find the beggar somewhere in Edron. Stay persistent, I'm sure he knows more than he wants to tell us.
npc.spectulus.say_30: [EN] Yes, maybe it was the right decision. Astronomical research is nothing for the faint-hearted.
npc.spectulus.say_31: [EN] Well, the... what? You... mean you're no longer interested? I see, well maybe I overestimated your spirit after all.
npc.spectulus.say_32: [EN] Alright, alright. You'll never find out the true secrets of life with such attitude, hm.
npc.spectulus.say_33: [EN] Come on, this is our only chance to finish the Lightboat.
npc.spectulus.say_34: [EN] Thought so. Well, no reason to be ashamed. I'll have to find help elsewhere now, though.
npc.spectulus.say_35: [EN] Come back if you made up your mind.
npc.spectulus.say_37: [EN] Then off you go! Im sorry that I cannot offer you any further help but Im sure you will find support along your way. And - be careful. The sea can appear pitch black down there.
npc.spectulus.say_38: [EN] Excellent, excellent. The rumours pointed to the north of Tiquanda, a sunken temple probably half drowned in water. Return to me if you find anything interesting!
npc.spectulus.say_39: [EN] Then off you go! I'm sorry that I cannot offer you any further help but I'm sure you will find support along your way. And - be careful. The sea can appear pitch black down there.
npc.spectulus.say_4: [EN] o have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is?  You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.say_5: [EN] So have you talked to the beggar? What did he tell you? Where are the plans...? Wh...? He did? He is? You've already got the plans? Beautiful!! Amazing! Alright it will take some time to recapitulate these plans.
npc.spectulus.say_6: [EN] It will take some time to work out the initial problem of the device. Come back when I've found the component needed to finish it. Alright, B connects to D and another two nails marked with S go... hmmm.
npc.spectulus.say_7: [EN] ...connects to N942. Alright!! That's it! I just finished a prototype device! And it looks like I figured out the initial failure. A very special crystal is needed for the device to work. Aren't you as curious as me to know what went wrong?
npc.spectulus.say_8: [EN] Did you enter the Lost Mines yet? They are west of Edron, close to the sea. You will also need a pick once you get to the crystal deposit.
npc.spectulus.say_9: [EN] Hm, so did you find a rare crystal? Show me... hey! That's not a rare crystal. What... where did you get that anyway? Please return to me with the right crystal.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_2: [EN] So my initial calculations had been correct!
npc.spectulus.stdmod_3: [EN] Looks like I have to find another way then.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_4: [EN] Hm, I need to recapitulate my equipment...
npc.spectulus.stdmod_5: [EN] I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.
npc.spectulus.stdmod_6: [EN] I heard of a device which would allow man to sail the sea of light. I call it the {Lightboat}, probably the most important invention in our history. And I will not rest until I have found a way to put the plan of its inventor into action.

npc.storkus.multi_1: [EN] Ding, dong, the vampire is dead, eh? So I guess ye' can return to Henricus and tell him that ye' finished your job here. I'm quite sure he has some more challenging task up his sleeve. ...
npc.storkus.multi_2: [EN] One more thing before ye' leave: I already mentioned the master vampires. ...
npc.storkus.multi_3: [EN] They are quite hard to find. If ye' stumble across one of them and manage to kill him, he will surely drop some token that proves his death. Bring me these tokens. ...
npc.storkus.multi_4: [EN] If ye' kill enough of them, I might have a little surprise for ye'.
npc.storkus.multi_5: [EN] While ye' were keeping the lower ranks busy, I could get valuable information about some vampire lords. ...
npc.storkus.multi_6: [EN] One of them is hiding somewhere beneath the Green Claw Swamp. I expect ye' to find him and kill him. ...
npc.storkus.multi_7: [EN] But be warned: Without good preparation, ye' might get into trouble. I hope for ye' he will be sleeping in his coffin when ye' arrive. ...
npc.storkus.multi_8: [EN] Before ye' open his coffin and drag that beast out to destroy it, I advise ye' to place some garlic necklaces on the stone slabs next to his coffin. That will weaken him considerably. ...
npc.storkus.multi_9: [EN] Bring me his ring as proof for his death. And now hurry and good hunt to ye'.
npc.storkus.say_1: [EN] So far ye've brought me {} of 20 {vampire dusts}. Do ye' have any more with ye'?
npc.storkus.say_10: [EN] Ye' brought the token needed to advance to the first vampire hunter rank. I consider that a fluke, but still, congrats! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_12: [EN] Ye' brought the four tokens needed to advance to the second vampire hunter rank. Pretty lucky ye' are! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_14: [EN] Ye' brought the five tokens needed to advance to the third vampire hunter rank. Wow, you're pretty determined! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_16: [EN] Ye' brought the ten tokens needed to advance to the fourth vampire hunter rank. You're absolutely painstaking! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_18: [EN] Ye' brought the thirty tokens needed to advance to the fifth vampire hunter rank. You're completely obliterative, kid! Let me share some of my experience with ye'.
npc.storkus.say_2: [EN] Fine, you're done! Ye' should talk to me about your {mission} again now.
npc.storkus.say_20: [EN] Ye' brought the fifty tokens needed to advance to the last vampire hunter rank. Now that's something. You're razing-amazing! Let me share some of my experience and a little something with ye'!
npc.storkus.say_22: [EN] As they might have told ye', I'm a vampire hunter. If ye' want to be of any help, ye' can assist me with some of my tasks and bring me 20 ounces of vampire dust. This gives me some time to concentrate on a bigger project.
npc.storkus.say_3: [EN] Have ye' killed the vampire lord? Because ye' have no his ring.
npc.storkus.say_4: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.storkus.say_5: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.storkus.say_6: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.storkus.say_7: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.storkus.say_8: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.storkus.say_9: [EN] Would ye' like to give me vampire tokens?
npc.strange_pipe.multi_1: [EN] You will have to leave the plant through the eastern door on the lowest level. I have arranged for it to be 'accidentally' open. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_10: [EN] They seem to have supplied him with resources and workforce and a powerful {guardian} to prevent anyone from entering the passages to his lair.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_11: [EN] He is an old enemy of the city and I've battled him often in the past. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_12: [EN] Now he has returned for vengeance, he reclaimed an old abandoned underground {laboratory} and he has acquired new powerful {allies}.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_2: [EN] As in the past, our enemy still uses a series of machines to open the way to the next section of his lair. You have to turn them all on to proceed. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_3: [EN] They will only work for a certain amount of time though, so you will have to hurry or some of the machines will turn inactive again.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_4: [EN] While it's buried, it only uses his tentacles to attack. If one is destroyed it will simply use another set of tentacles and its supply seems endless. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_5: [EN] If you manage though to kill all the tentacles it is using within a few heartbeats, it will become confused by its momentary helplessness and will probably attack with its main body. ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_6: [EN] That is when you have a chance to destroy it. Pass through its chamber and look for another of my tubes to contact me. Please hurry! End of communication.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_7: [EN] It's a fearsome subterranean beast like nothing I've ever encountered. It is dangerous and almost unbeatable because its main body is hidden beneath the ground ...
npc.strange_pipe.multi_8: [EN] And it has an endless supply of tentacles. But not all is lost, as I have devised a {plan} to battle the beast.
npc.strange_pipe.multi_9: [EN] His allies are an enigma even to me. It seems they belong to some unknown race that lives deep under the earth. ...
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_1: [EN] I can't reveal much to you right now as time is of the essence. I can tell you though that the glooth plant and the whole town are in danger and we have to act to stop a {madman} and his schemes.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_2: [EN] I defeated him there in the past. It has been abandoned for many {years}, but I suspected him to return from the dead eventually, as he has done so often before.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_3: [EN] The creature is powerful but not very clever. It seems it can be easily {enraged} and then it would likely let slip all caution and would relentlessly attack without regard for its safety.
npc.strange_pipe.stdmod_4: [EN] I used the time to prepare. You'll find my talking tubes all the {way} to his lair, and I can provide you with vital information about the things ahead.

npc.stricken_soul.greet_msg_1: [EN] This place is... haunted... heed my warning... there are... ghooooooosts here...! Why are you giving me that... look? I am certain, there aaaaaaare ghosts here - I've seen them! Do you believe me?
npc.stricken_soul.multi_2: [EN] . I will remember you. Now, lessons are every day in the morning and once a week in the evening... ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_3: [EN] Oh, you're not here for this, are you? So about the ghoooosts, yes. You seeeee, there are 3 secret passages here. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_4: [EN] Thiiiiis is no ordinary house... it is a nexus, a gateway to a once hidden cathedral. Sheltering a small and peaceful society of scholars and monks. Secluded from every distraction. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_5: [EN] I was one of them and ordered to hold contact to the outside woooorld. But then, something... happened. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_6: [EN] Outsiders managed to sneak in, infiltrate and influence the society... for the worse. Who knows for what ends. They chaaaaanged... ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_7: [EN] Shortly after, contact was lost... the nexus broken and sealed, ghosts appeared... eeeeeeeverywhere. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_8: [EN] Find the three passages... one is right here in the cellars, one in the jungles of Tiquanda and one in the deserts of Darama. ...
npc.stricken_soul.multi_9: [EN] Restore their connection and open this nexus to access the buried cathedral and find the cause to this... eliminate all remainders there if you must,
npc.stricken_soul.say_1: [EN] Excellent... I hope they will haaaaaaunt my house no longer. What was your... naaaaaame again, tell me?
npc.stricken_soul.say_2: [EN] Yeeeees... you need to help meeeeeee. I want those ghosts gone... this is my home and I need it to teach my students. Will you take care of the... ghosts?
npc.stutch.farewell_msg_1: [EN] LONG LIVE THE KING! You may leave now!
npc.stutch.stdmod_1: [EN] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.stutch.stdmod_2: [EN] MIND YOUR MANNERS COMMONER! To address the king greet with his title!
npc.sundara.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.sundara.voice_1: Poțiuni de sănătate! Poțiuni de mana! Cumpără-le aici!
npc.sundara.voice_2: Tot felul de poțiuni disponibile aici!
npc.suzy.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.suzy.voice_1: Nu uitați să vă depuneți banii aici în Banca Globală înainte de a pleca în aventură.
npc.sven.greet_msg_2: [EN] Iskan told me that you killed huskies here in Svargrond. I will be lenient towards you and won't ban you from Svargrond. But you have to pay me a compensation of 1500 gold for each husky you have killed. Are you willing to pay {}?
npc.sven.multi_1: [EN] Good, but to make barbarian mead we need some honey which is rare here. I'd hate to waste mead just to learn you're not worth it ...
npc.sven.multi_10: [EN] Return to me and talk about the {mammoth} pushing when you are done.
npc.sven.multi_11: [EN] An impressive start. Here, take your own mead horn to fill it at the mead bucket as often as you like ...
npc.sven.multi_12: [EN] But there is much left to be done. Your next test will be to hug a bear ...
npc.sven.multi_13: [EN] You will find one in a cave north of the town. If you are lucky, it's still sleeping. If not ... well that might hurt ...
npc.sven.multi_14: [EN] Unless you feel that you hugged the bear, the test is not passed. Once you are done, talk to me about the bear hugging.
npc.sven.multi_15: [EN] All of our juveniles have to take the barbarian test to become a true member of our community. Foreigners who manage to master the test are granted the title of an honorary barbarian and the respect of our people ...
npc.sven.multi_16: [EN] Are you willing to take the barbarian test?
npc.sven.multi_2: [EN] Therefore, you have to get your own honey. You'll probably need more than one try so better get some extra honeycombs. Then talk to me again about barbarian {mead}.
npc.sven.multi_3: [EN] That's the spirit! The barbarian test consists of a few tasks you will have to fulfill. All are rather simple - for a barbarian that is...
npc.sven.multi_4: [EN] Your first task is to drink some barbarian mead. But be warned, it's a strong brew that could even knock out a bear. You need to make at least ten sips of mead in a row without passing out to pass the test ...
npc.sven.multi_5: [EN] Do you think you can do this?
npc.sven.multi_6: [EN] As you have passed all three tests, I welcome you in our town as an honorary barbarian. You can now become a citizen. Don't forget to talk to the people here. Some of them might need some help ...
npc.sven.multi_7: [EN] We usually solve our problems on our own but some of the people might have a mission for you. Old Iskan, on the ice in the northern part of the town had some trouble with his dogs lately.
npc.sven.multi_8: [EN] Amazing. That was as clever and brave as a barbarian is supposed to be. But a barbarian also has to be strong and fearless. To prove that you will have to knock over a mammoth ...
npc.sven.multi_9: [EN] Did your face just turn into the color of fresh snow? However, you will find a lonely mammoth north west of the town in the wilderness. Knock it over to prove to be a true barbarian ...
npc.sven.say_1: [EN] I don't know if you realise the consequences. You won't be a member of our community anymore. I ask you for the last time: Are you willing to pay {} gold as a compensation?
npc.sven.say_2: [EN] Do you have some honey with you?
npc.sven.say_4: [EN] You don't have enough. Bring me the money and I will forget about it.
npc.sven.say_5: [EN] Good, for this honeycomb I allow you 20 sips from the mead bucket over there. Talk to me again about barbarian mead if you have passed the test.
npc.sven.say_6: [EN] Alright, it's your choice. If you regret your decision and want to be a barbarian again, talk to me about the {barbarian} test.
npc.svenson.say_1: [EN] Do you want to buy a heavy ball for 123 gold?
npc.svenson.stdmod_2: Am dori să vă servim ceva timp.
npc.svenson.stdmod_3: [EN] Where do you want to go? To {Tibia}, {Senja} or {Vega}?
npc.swolt.say_1: [EN] Here you go. {} rice balls. Hope you buy a beer with them at least.
npc.swolt.say_2: [EN] You don't have a ripe rice plant. Thank fire and earth I was spared.
npc.swolt.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Take a look, but not a sip before you've paid. And I hope it stays like this and you don't get any strange ideas about {rice}.
npc.swolt.stdmod_1: [EN] Well, you see me standing behind a bar. Selling drinks. Food. And stuff. Now try figuring out what I could be making a living of down here.
npc.swolt.stdmod_2: [EN] I can offer you bread, cheese, ham, or meat. And as drinks we serve beer and water. If you'd like to see what we have to offer, just ask me for a trade.
npc.taegen.multi_1: [EN] I don't have any gems. If you bring me some, I can craft a sun catcher for you. Do you have gems?
npc.taegen.multi_10: [EN] Have you found some raven herb?
npc.taegen.multi_11: [EN] Thank you! We are so happy. Now Aurita can take a walk on the beach. And I can visit her secret underwater grotto.
npc.taegen.multi_12: [EN] We are so happy. Now Aurita can take a walk on the beach. But I still can't visit her secret underwater grotto. To achieve this, we need something else: a very rare plant called raven herb. ...
npc.taegen.multi_13: [EN] If eaten it allows an air breathing creature to breathe underwater for a while. Please find this plant for me. But know that you'll only find it at night. It resembles a common fern but its leaves are of a lighter green.
npc.taegen.multi_14: Există o zână care mi-a spus odată despre această vrajă. Poate că își va împărtăși cunoștințele. O poți găsi într-un mic sat de zâne din sud-vestul Feyrist.
npc.taegen.multi_15: [EN] Yes, there is something. It's a bit embarassing, you must promise not to tell anyone else. I'm in love with Aurita. Well, that wouldn't be a reson to be ashamed, but she is a mermaid. ...
npc.taegen.multi_16: [EN] A faun on the other hand is inhabiting the forests, dancing with fairies and, well, nymphs. But I lost my heart to the lovely Aurita. I can't help it. We would love to spend some time together, but not just sitting on the beach. ...
npc.taegen.multi_17: [EN] I'd love to show her the deep forest I love so much. I have an idea but I can't do it alone. Would you help me?
npc.taegen.multi_2: [EN] Alright, I will craft a sun catcher for you.
npc.taegen.multi_3: [EN] I already crafted one sun catcher for you.
npc.taegen.multi_4: [EN] Please find this plant for me. But know that you'll only find it at night. It resembles a common fern but its leaves are of a lighter green.
npc.taegen.multi_5: [EN] Thank you, friend! Now I can visit Aurita in her underwater grotto!
npc.taegen.multi_6: [EN] That's very kind of you, my friend! Listen: I know there is a spell to transform her fishtail into legs. It is a temporary effect, so she could return to the ocean as soon as the spell ends. Unfortunately I don't know how to cast this spell. ...
npc.taegen.multi_7: Dar există o zână care mi-a spus odată despre asta. Poate că își va împărtăși cunoștințele. O poți găsi într-un mic sat de zâne din sud-vestul Feyrist.
npc.taegen.multi_8: [EN] Thank you again, mortal being. A sun catcher is similar to a dream catcher but other than the latter it can preserve sunlight rather than bad dreams. I can craft one out of enchanted branches of a fairy tree as well as several enchanted gems. ...
npc.taegen.multi_9: [EN] The branches are no problem, I will find some in the forest. But I don't have any gems. If you bring me some, I can craft a sun catcher for you. Do you have gems?
npc.taegen.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Im carving bolts and arrows and i also craft bows anda spears.If you'd like to buy some ammunition, take a look.
npc.taegen.voice_1: [EN] Id like to take a walk with Aurita.
npc.taegen.voice_3: [EN] Pas in boldly tyll thow com to an hall the feyrist undir sky ... *sings*
npc.talila.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Yes, i have some potions and runes if you are interested. Or do you want to buy only potions or only runes?oh if you want sell or buy gems, your may also ask me.
npc.talila.voice_1: [EN] Are you interested in a trade?
npc.talila.voice_2: [EN] Dont touch the wings, theyre delicate.
npc.talphion.say_1: [EN] DRESS FLATTEN? WHO WANTS ME TO FLATTEN A DRESS?
npc.talphion.say_2: [EN] A PRESS LANTERN? NEVER HEARD ABOUT IT!
npc.talphion.say_4: [EN] A PATTERN IN THIS MESS?? HEY DON'T INSULT MY MACHINE HALL!
npc.talphion.say_5: [EN] AH YES! I WORKED ON THE DRESS PATTERN FOR THOSE UNIFORMS. STAINLESS TROUSERES, STEAM DRIVEN BOOTS! ANOTHERMARVEL TO BEHOLD! I'LL SENT A COPY TO KEVIN IMEDIATELY!
npc.tamerin.multi_1: [EN] Why should I do something for another human being? I have been on my own for all those years. Hmm, but actually there is something I could need some assistance with. ...
npc.tamerin.multi_2: [EN] If you help me to solve my problems, I will help you with your mission. Do you accept?
npc.tamerin.say_1: [EN] You have kept your promise. Now, it's time to fulfil my part of the bargain. What kind of animals shall I raise? {Warbeasts} or {cattle}?
npc.tamerin.say_2: [EN] Thank you very much. As I said, as soon as you have helped me to solve both of my problems, we will talk about your mission. Have you killed {morik}?
npc.tamerin.say_3: [EN] Come back when you have the cure.
npc.tamerin.say_6: [EN] So he finally got what he deserved. As I said, as soon as you have helped me to solve both of my problems, we will talk about your {mission}.
npc.tamerin.say_7: [EN] Come back when you got rid with Morik.
npc.tamerin.say_8: [EN] I ask you for two things! For one thing, I need an animal cure and for another thing, I ask you to get rid of the gladiator Morik for me.
npc.tamoril.date_restriction: [EN] You can only discuss the First Dragon between January 14 and February 12.
npc.tamoril.greet_msg_1: [EN] Another pesky mortal who believes his gold outweighs his nutrition value.
npc.tamoril.multi_1: [EN] So listen: The lairs are secluded and you can only reach them by using a magical gem teleporter. You will find a teleporter carved out of a giant emerald in the dragon lairs deep beneath the Darama desert, which will lead you to Tazhadur's lair. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_10: [EN] These incitements are also a kind of trial that has to be undergone if one wants to {find} the First Dragon's four descendants.
npc.tamoril.multi_2: [EN] A ruby teleporter located in the western Dragonblaze Peaks allows you to enter the lair of Kalyassa. A teleporter carved out of sapphire is on the island Okolnir and leads you to Gelidrazah's lair. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_3: [EN] And finally an amethyst teleporter in undead-infested caverns underneath Edron allows you to enter the lair of Zorvorax.
npc.tamoril.multi_4: [EN]  Fine! I'll tell you where to find our ancestors. You now may ask yourself why I should want you to go there and fight them. It's quite simple: I am a straight descendant of Kalyassa herself. She was not really a caring mother. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_5: [EN] No, she called herself an empress and behaved exactly like that. She was domineering, farouche and conceited and this finally culminated in a serious quarrel between us. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_6: [EN] I sought support by my aunt and my uncles but they were not a bit better than my mother was! So, feel free to go to their lairs and challenge them. I doubt you will succeed but then again that's not my problem. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_7: [EN] So, you want to know about their secret lairs?
npc.tamoril.multi_8: [EN] Each kind of dragon has its own incitement, an important aspect that impels them and occupies their mind. For the common dragons this is the lust for power, for the dragon lords the greed for treasures. ...
npc.tamoril.multi_9: [EN] The frost dragons' incitement is the thirst for knowledge und for the undead dragons it's the desire for life, as they regret their ancestor's mistake. ...
npc.tamoril.say_1: [EN] The First Dragon? The first of all of us? The Son of Garsharak? I'm surprised you heard about him. It is such a long time that he wandered Tibia. Yet, there are some {rumours}.
npc.tamoril.say_2: [EN] It is told that the First Dragon had four {descendants}, who became the ancestors of the four kinds of dragons we know in Tibia. They perhaps still have knowledge about the First Dragon's whereabouts - if one could find them.
npc.tamoril.say_3: [EN] The names of these four are Tazhadur, Kalyassa, Gelidrazah and Zorvorax. Not only were they the ancestors of all dragons after but also the primal representation of the {draconic incitements}. About whom do you want to learn more?
npc.tamoril.say_4: [EN] What do you want to do, if you know about these mighty dragons' abodes? Go there and look for a fight?
npc.tandros.say_1: Desigur, răsfoiește-mi produsele. Puteți să vă uitați și la {}.
npc.tandros.voice_1: [EN] Potions, wands and runes for aspiring magicians.
npc.tanyt.farewell_msg_1: La revedere. Recomandați-ne dacă ați fost mulțumit de serviciile noastre.
npc.tanyt.greet_msg_1: [EN] Ah, the wind brings in another visitor. Welcome, dear guest. Are you looking for a {passage} with my carpet?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_1: Simte vântul în părul tău în timpul uneia dintre plimbările mele pe covor!
npc.tanyt.stdmod_10: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_11: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_4: Am dori să vă servim ceva timp.
npc.tanyt.stdmod_5: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_6: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_7: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_8: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, {Edron}, {Issavi}, {Svargrond}, {Kazordoon}, {Zao} or to {Femor Hills} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.stdmod_9: [EN] I can fly you to {Darashia}, to {Svargrond}, to {Kazordoon}, to {Zao}, to the {Femor Hills}, {Edron} or to {Marapur} if you like. Where do you want to go?
npc.tanyt.voice_1: Simte vântul în părul tău în timpul uneia dintre plimbările mele pe covor!
npc.tarak_inner.greet_msg_1: [EN] Can I interest you in a trip to the {monument tower}?
npc.tarak_inner.say_1: [EN] Do you want to travel to the {monument tower} for a 50 gold fee?
npc.tarak_sunken.greet_msg_1: [EN] Want to go back to Yalahar? Just ask me for a free {passage}.
npc.tarak_sunken.say_1: [EN] Do you want to go back to {Yalahar}?
npc.tarun.multi_1: [EN] So, he is dead as I feared. I warned him not to go with this woman, but he gave in to temptation. My heart darkens and moans. But you have my sincere thanks. ...
npc.tarun.multi_2: [EN] Without your help I would have stayed in the dark about his fate. Please, take this as a little recompense.
npc.tarun.multi_3: [EN] My brother is missing. I fear, he went to this evil palace north of here. A place of great beauty, certainly filled with riches and luxury. But in truth it is a threshold to hell and demonesses are after his blood. ...
npc.tarun.multi_4: [EN] He is my brother, and I am deeply ashamed to admit but I don't dare to go there. Perhaps your heart is more courageous than mine. Would you go to see this place and search for my brother?
npc.tarun.say_1: [EN] I hope you will find my brother.
npc.tarun.say_2: [EN] I thank you! This is more than I could hope!
npc.tarun.sendtrade_msg_1: [EN] Of course, just have a look.
npc.tefrit.say_1: [EN] Could you help me do a ritual?
npc.tefrit.say_2: [EN] Here is the list with the missing ingredients to complete the ritual.
npc.tefrit.say_4: [EN] Did you bring all the materials I informed you about?
npc.tefrit.say_5: [EN] Thank you this stage of the ritual is complete.
npc.tehlim.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello. I'm so glad someone has found me. Did you meet THEM?!
npc.tehlim.say_1: [EN] I warn you, those trolls are WAY more dangerous than the usual kind. Alone, I can't do anything for my brothers. Find a way to the trolls' hideout and rescue my brothers. Are you willing to help me?
npc.tehlim.say_2: [EN]  Great! I hope you find my brothers. Good luck!
npc.telas.say_1: [EN] I have heard only little about this mine. I am a bit absorbed in my studies. But what does this mine have to do with me?
npc.telas.say_2: [EN] You are starting this discussion again? Why should I listen to you this time, do you have anything to convince me to let you even try?
npc.telas.say_3: [EN] Well it sounds like a good idea to test my golems in some real environment. I think it is acceptable to send some of them to Farmine.
npc.telas.say_4: [EN] Well, of course my worker golems are quite usefull and it might indeed be a good idea to see who they operate on realistic conditions. I will send some to farmine soon.
npc.telas.say_5: [EN] Well, if the situation is that desperate I think it is possible to send some of the golems to help the poor dwarfs out of their misery.
npc.telas.say_6: [EN] Oh how nice of you. I might have misjudged you. So let us return to this matter of worker golems. Do you have any better arguments this time?
npc.tereban.cloth_deliver: [EN] Could you find the cloth I am looking for?
npc.tereban.cloth_done: [EN] Thanks to your efforts we have a suitable piece of spectral cloth.
npc.tereban.cloth_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. You will find it somewhere in the crypts under the Isle of the Kings. You will probably have to look for hidden caves when you don't find it at an obvious place. Perhaps you even need a shovel or a pick.
npc.tereban.cloth_no: [EN] Don't forget, you will find it somewhere in the crypts under the Isle of the Kings. You will probably have to look for hidden caves when you don't find it at an obvious place. Perhaps you even need a shovel or a pick.
npc.tereban.cloth_success: [EN] It looks a bit scary but I guess sorcerers might even find that appealing. Thank you very much.
npc.tereban.crystal_deliver: [EN] Did you find the required crystal?
npc.tereban.crystal_done: [EN] The crystal you have found is absolutely flawless. You did a great job indeed.
npc.tereban.crystal_failure_1: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. It is probably not easy to find the crystal that we need in such a huge desert which may contain several tombs, but please don't give up. ...
npc.tereban.crystal_failure_2: [EN] According to my sources the tomb we are looking for is east of Ankrahmun. You probably need a shovel to enter it. We still have some time and I am convinced you will find it.
npc.tereban.crystal_no_1: [EN] It is probably not easy to find the crystal that we need in such a huge desert which may contain several tombs, but please don't give up. ...
npc.tereban.crystal_no_2: [EN] According to my sources the tomb we are looking for is east of Ankrahmun. You probably need a shovel to enter it. We still have some time and I am convinced you will find it.
npc.tereban.crystal_success: [EN] Oh look at the colours and sparkles. This crystal is truly remarkable, thank you.
npc.tereban.greet_msg_1: [EN] Greetings, friend. Good you are showing up.
npc.tereban.iron_deliver: [EN] Have you found the iron that we need for the present?
npc.tereban.iron_done: [EN] The iron that you've found will make an ideal base for a shield.
npc.tereban.iron_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. I know it's not easy to find this iron but there has to be some in the deposits beneath the old Kazordoon mines. I doubt that it can be found in the newer mines outside of Kazordoon.
npc.tereban.iron_no: [EN] I know it's not easy to find this iron but there has to be some in the deposits beneath the old Kazordoon mines. I doubt it that it can be found in the newer mines outside of Kazordoon.
npc.tereban.iron_success: [EN] I wish there'd an easier way to get that iron but those dwarfs are so stubborn. However, now we got what we need.
npc.tereban.root_deliver: [EN] Could you find the root which we are looking for?
npc.tereban.root_done: [EN] It is even recognisable for me that the root you gave me is filled with magic.
npc.tereban.root_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. The best advice I can give you is to look underground beneath the city for a suitable root.
npc.tereban.root_no: [EN] The best advice I can give you is to look underground beneath the city for a suitable root.
npc.tereban.root_success: [EN] You are admirably determined in fulfilling your task. I will make sure that my sons appreciate what you did for their presents.
npc.tereban.scale_deliver: [EN] Could you get Glitterscale's scales yet?
npc.tereban.scale_done: [EN] Only someone as daring as you could slay the beast to get the necessary scales.
npc.tereban.scale_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Oh please, search for Glitterscale. It should not be too hard to find it in those caves north of Thais.
npc.tereban.scale_no: [EN] Oh please, search for Glitterscale. It should not be too hard to find it in those caves north of Thais.
npc.tereban.scale_success: [EN] These scales must have belonged to a fearsome beast. I envy you for your bravery.
npc.tereban.silk_deliver: [EN] So you've found the silk that I need?
npc.tereban.silk_done: [EN] The silk you have brought me is exquisite indeed.
npc.tereban.silk_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_no: [EN] Then search the spider caves of the continent Zao for the silk. They have to be somewhere in the east of Zao's southern part. My sources claim there you will find the silk that we need.
npc.tereban.silk_success: [EN] Great. I better don't think about how big a spider has to be to produce such strands of silk.
npc.tereban.sinew_deliver: [EN] Do you have the required sinew?
npc.tereban.sinew_done: [EN] Your bravery earned us this excellent sinew.
npc.tereban.sinew_failure: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_no: [EN] Perhaps Heoni was out to hunt when you were looking for it. Search in the mountains of Edron. I put my trust in your abilities.
npc.tereban.sinew_success: [EN] Ah, not only did you bring some sinew to me, you also made the world a safer place by killing Heoni.
npc.tereban.wood_deliver: [EN] Could you find the wood we were talking about?
npc.tereban.wood_done: [EN] The wood you have found is just what we needed.
npc.tereban.wood_failure_1: [EN] Sorry, you must be wrong. The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. ...
npc.tereban.wood_failure_2: [EN] It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_no: [EN] The wood that I need should be in one of the barbarian camps. It seems logical to search the most northern camp first, it is closest to the place where the tree was cut. Please hurry, there is still so much to do before the birthday.
npc.tereban.wood_success: [EN] Thank you. I feel somewhat embarrassed to put you into such a danger for some birthday present but I am sure you can handle it.
npc.tereban_functions.multi_1: [EN] I have four sons which are very dear to me. Though they were born on the same day and even in the same hour, they took quite different paths in life. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_10: [EN] I met this troll when he was hanging around near the town. He carried something I would consider rather uncharacteristic for a troll: a stunningly beautiful cloak entirely made of white feathers. I was curious and asked him if he would sell it. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_11: [EN] He seemed to be more interested in some of my coins and a piece of meat than in this unusual garment. Therefore, we made a trade: He got some meat and coins and I got the cloak. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_12: [EN] I had a clue that it was a magical item but nobody in Edron knew something about it. As I have a very lettered friend in Darashia I took a magical carpet flight to visit him and ask him about the cloak. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_13: [EN] But then something very annoying happened: During the flight the wind blew so strongly that it tattered the cloak. Feather after feather was blown off the carpet but I didn't realise it. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_14: [EN] When I reached Darashia there was no cloak just a handful of feathers. *sighs* I'm not sure whether it makes sense to search for these feathers. There was a small wind gust when we were still above Edron. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_15: [EN] But the actual storm began when we were in the air above the Darama. The feathers are now scattered all over the desert I guess. Rather futile to look out for them but if you really want to try: ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_16: [EN] The magic carpet made a beeline from Edron to Darashia. You should search along this line on the ground. Good luck!
npc.tereban_functions.multi_2: [EN] Each of them chose a different vocation, one will become a knight, one a sorcerer, one a druid, and the other a paladin. In a few weeks they will reach adulthood and I am holding a birthday party for them. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_3: [EN] It should become a day to remember and so I want to give them something special as a present. I searched the land for the finest craftsmen so they could create suitable presents for my sons. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_4: [EN] But something of fine craftsmanship will just not cut it. So I asked them what they would need to create something special. They all came up with lists of rare and expensive items necessary for the task ahead. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_5: [EN] I spent a small fortune to buy most of the materials but in the end the key components are that rare that they cannot be simply bought somewhere. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_6: [EN] As far as I understood it, the places where you can get these items are quite dangerous and so it would take some adventurer to get them. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_7: [EN] That would be your mission if you are interested. Uhm, so are you interested?
npc.tereban_functions.multi_8: [EN] I'm so glad I finally have all the parts for the presents. Your reward is my eternal gratitude. Well, that and some gold of course. ...
npc.tereban_functions.multi_9: [EN] Take this sachet over there, I wrapped the coins into this old cape I had still lying around here from a barter with a stranger, it is of no use for me anyway. Farewell and thank you once again.
npc.tereban_functions.say_2: [EN] Well, I need the parts of a sorcerer's robe, a paladin's bow, a knight's shield, and a druid's rod. If you cannot find one of them, ask me about it and I might provide you with some minor hints.
npc.tereban_functions.say_4: [EN] I am relieved someone as capable as you will handle the task. Well, I need the parts of a sorcerer's robe, a paladin's bow, a knight's shield, and a druid's wand.
npc.tereban_functions.say_5: [EN] Oh my. I really hope you will change your mind.
npc.terrence.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey there, you are surely interested in helping the Rathleton city guard, right? Right - especially now since the dreaded minotaurs gain more ground every day.
npc.terrence.say_1: [EN] I'm not allowed to let just anyone pass. If you have proven your willingness and effort to participate in the fighting, I'm allowed to let you pass.
npc.terrence.say_3: [EN] You fought hard enough against the minotaurs. Since you've shown so much effort in our war, I'll let you pass through the gate.
npc.tesha.greet_msg_1: Da? Ce pot face pentru tine, |PLAYERNAME|? Afaceri bancare, poate?
npc.tesha.voice_1: Nu uitați să vă depuneți banii aici în Banca Globală înainte de a pleca în aventură.
npc.testserver_assistant.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hey {}. I'm Testserver Assistant and I can give {money}, {experience} and {blessing} which will be useful for testing on {} server. You can too to back to level 8 with {reset}.
npc.testserver_assistant.say_2: [EN] You can not take it anymore
npc.testserver_assistant.say_4: [EN] You have been blessed by all gods, |PLAYERNAME|.
npc.testserver_assistant.say_5: [EN] You can not take it anymore
npc.thanita.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.thanita.greet_msg_1: [EN] How could you sneak up on me like this? I thought you were one of THEM! Well, since you are not, what brings you to this wilderness?
npc.thanita.multi_1: [EN] Oh great! Supplies from Carlin! Let me see ...<she digs into the parcel>...ahh, nothing meaningful at all, like always. Well, before I give you the password for the delivery, you have to help me! ...
npc.thanita.multi_2: [EN] I have massive problems with the goblin tribe that lives here. You look strong enough to face their leader but you need to be smart to lure him out. ...
npc.thanita.multi_3: [EN] I heard they don't like fire very much, maybe that's worth a try. Their beds are mostly made of straw which is known as easily inflammable. ...
npc.thanita.multi_4: [EN] The entrance to their cave is at the pond south east of here.
npc.thanita.say_1: [EN] Impressive!! I could need someone like you here at the watchtower! Okay, the password you need to tell Bunny is ' password* '. Come back and visit me if you like to!
npc.thanita.walkaway_msg_1: [EN] Take good care of yourself traveller. Would be a shame to lose such a courageous wanderer to those green monsters.
npc.the_beggar_king.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hi! You look like someone on a {mission}.
npc.the_beggar_king.multi_1: [EN] Fine. But the first thing you have to know is that we are not the city's problem. We are just trying to survive. We usually seek shelter in the sewers.
npc.the_beggar_king.multi_2: [EN] There we are comparatively warm and safe. At least we were. But recently something has changed. There is {something} in the sewers. And it is hunting us.
npc.the_beggar_king.say_1: [EN] Some parts of the sewers were abandoned when they were beyond repair due to old age and earthquakes. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_2: [EN] That part was never truly well liked. There were rumours that the workers found some ancient structures there and that it was ripe with accidents during the construction. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_3: [EN] The city sealed those parts off, and I have no idea how anything could get in or out without the permission of the magistrate. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_4: [EN] But since you are investigating on their behalf, you might work out some agreement with them, if you're mad enough to enter the sewers at all. ...
npc.the_beggar_king.say_5: [EN] However, you will have to talk to one of the Glooth Brothers who are responsible for the sewer system's maintenance. You'll find them somewhere down there.
npc.the_blind_prophet.greet_msg_1: [EN] Be greeted, friend of the apes.
npc.the_blind_prophet.say_13: [EN] You want me to transport you to forbidden land?
npc.the_blind_prophet.say_15: [EN] You are not worthy to be transported there yet.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_1: [EN] Me put name away name long ago. Now only blind prophet of ape people are.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_10: [EN] Our people a lot to learn have. One day we might live in peace with you hairless apes, who knows.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_11: [EN] Me not know. Me seldom have visions of not banana related objects.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_2: [EN] Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_4: [EN] Me is who in dreams speak to holy banana. Me divine the will of banana.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_5: [EN] Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_6: [EN] Me guard the forbidden land behind the great palisade. If any want to enter, he must ask me for transport.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_7: [EN] Good ape he is. Has to work hard to make other apes listen but you helped a lot.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_8: [EN]  Our holy ancestor he is. Big as mountain. Lizards say they built palisade to keep him but we not believe ... We think Bong palisade built to have peace from pesky lizards. We respect peace of Bong, keep people away from forbidden land.
npc.the_blind_prophet.stdmod_9: [EN]  The lizards evil and vengeful are. Ape people on guard must be.
npc.the_bone_master.multi_1: [EN] Welcome to the Brotherhood! From now on you will walk the path of Bones. A life full of promises and power has just beenoffered to you ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_2: [EN] Take it, if you are up to that challenge ... or perish in agony if you deserve this fate ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_3: [EN] You can always ask me about your current rank and about the privileges the ranks grant to those who hold them.
npc.the_bone_master.multi_4: [EN] But know that your decision will be irrevocable. You will abandon the opportunity to join any order whose doctrine is incontrast to our own ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_5: [EN] Do you still want to join the Brotherhood?
npc.the_bone_master.multi_6: [EN] The Brotherhood of Bones has suffered greatly in the past, but we did survive as we always will ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_7: [EN] You have proven resourceful by beating the silly riddles the Nightmare Knights set up to test their candidates ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_8: [EN] It's an amusing thought that after passing their test you might choose to join the ranks of their sworn enemies ...
npc.the_bone_master.multi_9: [EN] For the irony of this I ask you, |PLAYERNAME|: Do you want to join the Brotherhood of Bones?
npc.the_bone_master.say_1: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Hyaena} rank? Did you bring 500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_2: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Death Dealer} rank? Did you bring 1000 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_3: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Dread Lord} rank? Did you bring 1500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_bone_master.say_4: [EN] You advanced to {Hyaena} rank! You are now able to use teleports of second floor of Knightwatch Tower.
npc.the_bone_master.say_5: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_bone_master.say_7: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_bone_master.say_8: [EN] You advanced to {Dread Lord} rank! You are now able to use teleports of fourth floor of Knightwatch Tower and to create addon scrolls.
npc.the_bone_master.say_9: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.farewell_msg_1: [EN] Good bye. May the gods watch over your path.
npc.the_dream_master.multi_1: [EN] So I welcome you as the latest member of the order of the Nightmare Knights. You entered this place as a stranger, butyou will leave this place as a friend ...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_2: [EN] You can always ask me about your current rank and about the privileges the ranks grant to those who hold them.
npc.the_dream_master.multi_3: [EN] The Nightmare Knights are almost extinct now, and as far as I know I am the only teacher that is left. But you might beright and its time to accept new disciples ...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_4: [EN] After all you have passed the Dream Challenge to reach this place, which used to be the process of initiation in the past...
npc.the_dream_master.multi_5: [EN] So I ask you: do you wish to become a member of the ancient order of the Nightmare Knights, |PLAYERNAME|?
npc.the_dream_master.say_1: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Initiate} rank? Did you bring 500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_10: [EN] You advanced to {Lord Protector} rank! You are now able to use teleports of fourth floor of Knightwatch Tower and to create addon scrolls.
npc.the_dream_master.say_11: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.say_2: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Dreamer} rank? Did you bring 1000 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_3: [EN] So you want to advance to a {Lord Protector} rank? Did you bring 1500 demonic essences with you?
npc.the_dream_master.say_4: [EN] Please know that your decision is irrevocable. You will abandon the opportunity to join any order whose doctrine is incontrast to our own ...
npc.the_dream_master.say_5: [EN] Do you still want to join our order?
npc.the_dream_master.say_6: [EN] You advanced to {Initiate} rank! You are now able to use teleports of second floor of Knightwatch Tower.
npc.the_dream_master.say_7: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_dream_master.say_9: [EN] Come back when you gather all essences.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_2: [EN] You succeeded! Issavi is safe again. Take this as a sign of our grace and gratitude, brave mortal being. It is a precious relic from earlier times. More precisely, it is one of four parts of the relic called the Regalia of Suon. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_3: [EN] Should you ever find the other three parts, a talented jeweler might be able to combine them and recreate the regalia for you.
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_4: [EN] I see. There is enough and adequate evidence that the Ambassador of Rathleton is indeed an arch traitor. So, Eshaya was right. Well done, mortal being. You have proven your loyalty and bravery, therefore allow me to ask you one more favour. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_5: [EN] The Cult of Fafnar is a serious problem for Issavi. The cultists are roaming the sewers and catacombs beneath the city now and again but this time they are really up to something. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_6: [EN] As a member of the Sapphire Blade found out, they are planning to cause a major earthquake, that could severely damage or even destroy Issavi. You may wonder how. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_7: [EN] Well, they want to activate five Fafnar statues which they have already enchanted. They are hidden in the catacombs underneath the city. Please go down and search for the statues. ...
npc.the_empress.greet_msg_8: [EN] Then use this sceptre to bless them in the name of Suon and Bastesh. This will destroy the disastrous enchantment and Issavi will be safe again.
npc.the_first_dragon.greet_msg_1: [EN] Hello, my sparring buddy. We should have another fight sometimes. I think you may have earned a little reward.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_1: [EN] The definition of finer things is different for a dragon than for a human. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_10: [EN] Books are a wonderful {invention}. If you are ever tired of your heroic exploits, take the time to read one.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_11: [EN] The world has changed so much; I'm beginning to feel really old. People have changed, the face of the world has changed, even the laws of nature are no longer the same. ...
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_12: [EN] I think it is the greatest advantage of you {humans} to be more flexible and adaptable.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_13: [EN] In hindsight I'm not too proud of this. This was some kind of juvenile bullying.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_14: [EN] In hindsight I'm not too proud of this. This was some kind of juvenile bullying.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_15: [EN] This led to certain vulnerabilities. However, the dragons overcame such shortcomings quickly and soon took their rightful place in the food chain, so to say.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_16: [EN] This led to certain vulnerabilities. However, the dragons overcame such shortcomings quickly and soon took their rightful place in the food chain, so to say.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_17: [EN] They used {weaknesses} to their advantage. It took some time before a dragon could be killed in a fair fight.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_18: [EN] They used {weaknesses} to their advantage. It took some time before a dragon could be killed in a fair fight.
npc.the_first_dragon.multi_19: [EN] I really enjoy a good fight now and then. ...
